title: Temelli: A new constitution cannot be discussed without Öcalan’s involvement
content:
As the Peace and Democratic Society Process, launched following Abdullah Öcalan’s call, reaches a critical stage, Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) Deputy Group Chair Sezai Temelli spoke to ANF about Turkey’s economic crisis, the government’s approach to the process, Öcalan’s status as Parliament opened.


Turkey is one of the world’s five fragile economies


Temelli addressed the recent rise in fuel prices, the fund crisis and deepening poverty in Turkey, saying that the country’s economy remained structurally fragile: “Turkey’s economy is fundamentally fragile. It is one of the five fragile economies in the world, and this fragility simply does not go away. There are many reasons for this. There are structural problems as well as administrative and institutional ones. Of course, the current political situation also has a very serious impact. As a result, this fragile economy constantly generates crises. Because of this persistent mentality of plunder, it repeatedly produces cases of profiteering and corruption.


A very significant part of Turkey’s economy is already informal, and within that informal economy there is what we call the black economy as well as the grey economy. It is an economy with high unemployment that is trying to stay afloat amid high inflation and high interest rates, but beyond that, it has failed to meet social expectations or resolve social problems. Looking at all of this, the latest fund crisis was not actually unexpected.”


Temelli said similar crises had occurred throughout the Justice and Development Party’s (AKP) many years in power, adding that the government’s approach to economic management had contributed to their emergence.


The logic of a war economy remains intact


Temelli said one of the structural problems facing Turkey’s economy was that it remained a war economy, adding that the step taken by Abdullah Öcalan and the political climate he had created presented an important opportunity for Turkey: “One of the most important structural problems in the economy is this: it is a war economy. We are going through an important period. The step taken by Mr. Öcalan, the initiative he has taken and the political climate he has created are so valuable and important that anyone looking at the situation from the outside would say this is a major opportunity for Turkey. An outside observer would see it as a major opportunity for Turkey. Why? Because this may give Turkey, perhaps for the first time, an opportunity to normalise both its politics and its economy.


The impact of the process is not reflected in the 2027 budget. We are faced with a government that still retains the logic and underlying structures of a war economy.”


The issue is still approached as a fight against terrorism


Temelli said Turkey’s economy could improve if a significant proportion of the resources allocated to the war were redirected to the economy: “More than $40 billion a year is spent on the war. There is now an opportunity to redirect at least two-thirds of the resources allocated to the war economy. That would amount to around $20–25 billion. For Turkey’s economy, $20–25 billion could provide a significant means of improvement. But that option has not been chosen. This is the first structural problem, and despite the profound impact this process could have, no steps are being taken to address it. That is because we are still faced with an approach that views the issue as a fight against terrorism and continues to shape its politics accordingly.”


Democracy and the economy must advance together


Temelli said economic problems could not be addressed separately from democratisation, arguing that the absence of democracy in politics led to greater corruption in the economy: “First and foremost, this government is avoiding democracy. If there is no democracy in politics, there will also be a great deal of corruption in the economy. We need to understand that the two go hand in hand. The more democratic politics becomes, the more democratic the economy becomes. Democratising the economy essentially means ensuring economic justice. This government is avoiding that. We are faced with a government that has nothing to do with democracy, either in politics or in the economy. What does it do? It uses an authoritarian political system to create an economic sphere for profiteering and plunder.”

title: Journalist Derya Okatan remanded in custody
content:
Derya Okatan, a journalist and member of the Disciplinary Board of the Press-Iş union of the Confederation of Progressive Trade Unions of Turkey (DISK), was detained at her home in Ankara and taken to Istanbul Çağlayan Courthouse. Okatan was referred to a judge with a request for her arrest without even having her statement taken by the prosecutor. The court subsequently ordered Derya Okatan’s detention pending trial.


The Dicle Fırat Journalists Association (DFG) reacted to Derya Okatan’s arrest. The DFG said: “We stand with Derya Okatan against the criminalization of journalistic activities and attempts to silence journalists through pressure and arrests, and we demand her immediate release. Journalism is not a crime.”

title: KNK conference begins: Kurds seek representation and status at the UN
content:
The Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) hosts a conference in Brussels with the aim of securing Kurdish representation at the United Nations (UN) and gaining international status, has begun. Attended by representatives of political parties and organizations from the four parts of Kurdistan and various countries around the world, as well as academics and experts in international law, the conference will discuss diplomatic efforts aimed at ensuring that 60 million Kurds are represented internationally with their own identity and political will.


The conference, held at Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB), is attended by American legal expert Barry Fisher, academic Miloon Kothari, who has worked within the United Nations, and his wife, as well as former Icelandic Foreign Minister Ögmundur Jónasson, and Coni Ledesma, who works in the field of international law.


The conference began with the singing of the Kurdish anthem “Ey Reqîb” and a one-minute silence. This was followed by the election of the conference presidium. Fehmi Vergili, Nilüfer Koç and Wirya Qaradaxi were elected to the presidium.


Nilüfer Koç: Why don’t Kurds speak in their own name?


Delivering the first speech on behalf of the presidium, Nilüfer Koç drew attention to the fact that Kurds have been left without a name or identity in the international arena for nearly a century. Asking, “Why don’t Kurds, like other nations, speak in their own name?” Koç stated that the main purpose of the conference was to discuss this question and the issue of Kurdish representation at the international level. She said that the identity of 60 million Kurds and their right to representation would be addressed, adding that the KNK has been working intensively on this initiative for nearly a year.


Zeynep Murad: A long-term and strategic mission


KNK Co-Chair Zeynep Murad said that they have been carrying out diplomatic efforts for nearly a year and have held meetings with political parties and organizations in Kurdistan. Stating that these efforts have been conducted by the KNK’s diplomacy group, Murad emphasized that the mission is long-term and strategic in nature.


“Sixty million people live in their own geography with their culture and identity. Yet they have no representation in an international institution. Today, we will hold a discussion on this issue,” she said.


Karamus: A common national position must be developed


KNK Co-Chair Ahmet Karamus said that the conference marked a historic day for the Kurdish people’s struggle. Stating that the demand for status in all four parts of Kurdistan and representation at the UN has now emerged as a common agenda, Karamus said:


“Today is a historic day in the Kurdish people’s struggle. Today is a day when the issue of the Kurdish people’s status in all four parts has taken shape in people’s minds. All four parts now demand representation and status at the UN.”


Karamus said that serious, sensitive and risky changes are taking place around the world, in the Middle East and across the four parts of Kurdistan, adding that the emerging new process brings both risks and significant opportunities for the Kurdish movement and the future of the Kurdish people.


Emphasizing that successfully advancing this process is essential for the existence, will and struggle of the Kurdish people, Karamus stressed the need to develop unity and a common national position in the face of the threats confronting them. He said that the application process initiated to secure status for the Kurdish people at the UN would contribute to greater Kurdish unity, adding, “Our people must remain united throughout this process.”


Karamus noted that the KNK has so far made intensive efforts toward national unity but has not yet achieved the desired results. He said that, as part of preparations for the UN application, a delegation had been formed to conduct work in different regions in order to assess and discuss the situation on the ground.


He stated that the planned work had been carried out in Rojava, Bakur and Europe, while meetings had also been held in Sulaymaniyah, Qandil and Hewlêr (Erbil).


Karamus stated that meetings with all political parties and sides had yielded positive results, saying: “For the first time, we held meetings and discussions with all political parties and the administration in Bashur (South) Kurdistan. This has generated great hope. In this new process, we now have both the hope and the opportunity to act together and in …

title: DİH okullarda 1 öğün ücretsiz yemek hakkını AYM’ye taşıdı
content:
Demokrasi İçin Hukukçular (DİH), okullarda bir öğün ücretsiz, sağlıklı yemek hakkı için verilen mücadeleyi Anayasa Mahkemesine taşıdı. Sosyal medya hesaplarında yaptıkları açıklamada, “Anayasa Mahkemesinin çocukların eşit-parasız eğitim, maddi ve manevi varlığını geliştirme hakkını önceleyen bir karar vermesini talep etmek hakkımız” ifadeleri kullanıldı.

DİH açıklamasında; kadınların, sendikaların, siyasi partilerin ve meslek örgütlerinin sürdürdüğü mücadele sonucu 2022-2023 eğitim öğretim yılının ikinci yarısından itibaren okul öncesi eğitimdeki öğrencilere uygulanan ücretsiz beslenme uygulamasının 11 Eylül 2023’te Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB) tarafından kaldırıldığı hatırlatıldı.

Uygulamanın kaldırılması üzerine MEB’e açılan davada Danıştay 8. Dairesinin “devletin mali kaynaklarının yetersizliği, idarenin çocuklara yemek vermekte takdir serbestisi olduğunu” belirttiği dile getirilerek davanın reddedildiği ifade edildi. Bu durumun çocukların üstün yararı, Anayasa ve uluslararası sözleşmeleri göz ardı eden bir karar olduğu belirtilerek 2 Ekim 2026’da Anayasa Mahkemesine başvurulduğu ilan edildi.

Türkiye’de yaşanan fon vurgununa işaret edilen açıklamada, “İktidar temsilcilerinin, çocukların açlığını temel gündem yapması gereken eski Aile Bakanı ve pek çok iktidar elitinin haksız işlemlerle edindiği kişisel servetin, fonculara akan kaynağın ‘çok küçük bir kısmı’ bile çocukların beslenmesini sağlayabilirdi” denildi.

Çocuk açlığını devletin takdir yetkisine bırakan sürecin “Ailem Güvende” operasyonlarıyla da birlikte değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtilerek, “Çocuğun beslenme sorununu çözemeyen aileler güvende değildir, kimlerin ve hangi ailelerin güvende olduğunu ise hep birlikte görmekteyiz” ifadeleri kullandı.

Çocuk açlığına karşı, her çocuğun eğitim hakkına eşit bir biçimde erişebilmek için mücadelenin devam edeceği söylenen açıklamada, “Anayasa Mahkemesinin çocukların eşit-parasız eğitim, maddi ve manevi varlığını geliştirme hakkını önceleyen bir karar vermesini talep etmek hakkımız” denildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: It’s not just ‘know your audience’. Having one set of words for the in-crowd and one set of words…
content:
queershephard

:

queeranarchism

:

queeranarchism

:

A lot of people become insufferable when you point out that

“You need to learn a dozen new 6-syllable words derived from Greek to participate in our conversation”

and

“our entire community is white college-graduates and all our efforts to diversify have failed”

constantly overlap for really obvious reasons.

#you would think those 6 syllable words were being taken away

Well, yes, kinda. I’m not cancelling words but I am challenging people to think of possible easier words.

If the best thing we can come up with for “stop doing man/woman and cis/trans binaries!” is ‘exorsexism’, we’re shit at accessible communication. Sorry, not sorry.

If the Germans can call combined oral contraceptives 'anti-baby-pills’, then we can decide to come up with simpler, more intuitive and easier-to-remember words for the concepts that we want a lot of people of all backgrounds to understand.

So many replies and responses are essentially versions of “oh so you want us to reduce language and only use stupid words” and the actual point OP is making is — know your audience.

Creating jargon is absolutely fine. Having new words to describe complex sociological issues is absolutely fine. But MOST people aren’t at a place to intuitively understand jargon. And so if you’re trying to create a mass politic for the left, do you want to sound ‘smart’ or do you want to build a coalition? Because if you want to coalition, you have to know who you’re talking to and what words will be effective and how your message can come across.

Otherwise you’re just being Sheldon Cooper from the Big Bang Theory, and you will turn people off not because you’re wrong, but because you are perceived as a know-it-all condescending prick (regardless of your intent).


It’s not just 'know your audience’. Having one set of words for the in-crowd and one set of words for everyone else would just amplify the effect where a lot of people just do not feel welcome in our spaces because they sound like white academia spaces.

So I’m also saying: if we’re creating jargon, why are we constantly creating jargon by borrowing from the academic tradition of

 'translate it to greek or latin and slap it all together into one word’?

instead of thinking 'what word is easy to remember and easy to understand for the largest number of people’?

Antibabypille is six syllables, but most people would know what it means without anyone explaining the meaning, and after hearing it once or twice they would remember it and be able to use it in a sentence. That’s what good jargon could try to be like.

title: Xebat Andok: The process needs to become more inclusive of society
content:
KCK Executive Council member Xebat Andok gave an in-depth interview to Stêrk TV.


The first part of the interview can be read

here

. 


The Peace and Democratic Society Process has been ongoing for two years. But when we look at the Turkish side – specifically the role that the media is playing – even their rhetoric hasn’t changed. Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan is being directly targeted. At the same time, they are not granting him any means to defend himself. Is their still an opposition to the Peace and Democratic Society Process?


Yes, there are certain circles, both inside and outside the country, that oppose the process. One has to look at the Turkish state’s media and their rhetoric. Then again, state officials have made various statements from time to time. They said that they would change the narrative of their media. But to this day, we haven’t really seen much of that. They act opportunistically from time to time. Sometimes people wonder if they’ll make some changes, but then they revert to their default settings. The reason for this isn’t that journalists perceive these issues correctly or speak about them in that way. No, that’s not the source of the problem. Essentially, everyone knows that journalism in Turkey is dependent on the Turkish state in every respect. It is primarily the state itself that coordinates them and sets their daily agenda. Therefore, if they truly wanted to – if they genuinely sought to prepare Turkish society for this process – they could change the language of the media to some extent.


If there were an independent media, they would express their own independent views. But there is no such thing. But the source is still the state’s approach. In other words, because the state’s approach is flawed, the media’s approach is the same. The free press, for instance, is not like that. The free press has truly changed its rhetoric and its approach. There are, of course, shortcomings, but at least, in order for the process to succeed, it’s trying to act in accordance with the spirit of the process. People can at least see and feel this effort. But nothing like this is seen in the Turkish press. In fact, they play the exact opposite role. There are different approaches – different approaches from international powers. There are also differences among social forces, among the Kurds, and within Turkey itself. Not everyone takes this approach. Who wouldn’t want Turkey to become more democratic? There are those who take this approach. Among the Kurds, too, there are those with different views. They identify themselves in different ways. But ultimately, there are approaches that, through their actions and words, do nothing but harm the Kurdish and Kurdistan cause. However, they are not very numerous. They do not play a decisive role and are not able to disrupt the process.


Then again, there is also the level of the international powers. They are, after all, responsible for the emergence of the Kurdish issue. It is these international powers that created the Kurdish issue alongside the Turkish nation-state mentality. And they see themselves as the masters of the world. Kurdistan is a highly strategic location. All of these powers are in the Middle East. And they have a mindset of interventionism. They have their own views and practices regarding the process. They exert a great deal of influence on the process to ensure it becomes even more uncertain or progresses even slower so that it cannot achieve its own objectives in a short time. There are certain efforts and projects aimed at worsening the situation, as well as numerous different promises regarding the dynamics of the Kurdish people. Because they form a very large force, and everyone acknowledges this. Their numbers are estimated at around 60 million. They are scattered all over the world. But now, they are asserting their existence. They no longer accept their absence and are fighting back. They are acting without a state or a defined identity. They have immense potential to harness this dynamic for their own purposes. Therefore, to prevent the emergence of measures that are misguided – that do not serve the Kurdish people, the peoples of the region, or even the states in the region – the Turkish state must approach this issue with a more trustworthy stance from the outset. If this does not happen, there are far too many factors that will undermine this process.

title: Podcast de l'émission « Médias et antifascisme » du 11 septembre 2026 avec Pierre Salmon
content:
L'émission «

 

Médias et antifascisme

 

» présente tous les deuxièmes vendredis du mois à 11h30 sur Radio Libertaire (89.4

FM

 en Île-de-France et anarchiste.info/radio/libertaire) recevait le 11 septembre 2026 l'historien Pierre Salmon coauteur du nouveau livre «

 

La guerre d'Espagne 1936‐1939. La démocratie assassinée

 

» sorti le 12 mars 2026 aux éditions Tallandier :

https://www.anarchiste.info/radio/libertaire/emission/medias-et-antifascisme/2026/09/11/

.


Nous évoquions avec Mariama des émissions "Pas de Quartiers" et "La Rage Dedans" la montée du franquisme à la faveur notamment des guerres coloniales menées par l'Espagne à Cuba et au Maroc.


Nous analysions comment Franco s'est soulevé contre la République grâce à des forces structurées de longue date. Nous récusons donc la mythologie véhiculée notamment par Le Figaro Histoire qui dans son numéro d'août‐septembre 2026 martèle que la République espagnole n'était qu'un instrument entre les mains de l'Union Soviétique.


Nous abordions de plus des sujets d'actualité concernant justement Cuba et le Maroc. Le blocus imposé à Cuba par les États‐Unis d'Amérique et l'arrivée de plusieurs dizaines de milliers de personnes dans la ville espagnole de Ceuta nous permettent de comprendre certains enjeux internationaux.


Le gouvernement de Pedro Sánchez, qui a reconnu en 2024 l'État de Palestine et qui refuse aux États‐Unis d'Amérique l'accès à son territoire pour bombarder l'Iran est en effet particulièrement fragilisé par la situation. La décision début août du roi du Maroc de nommer l'autoroute qui mène au Sahara occidental «

 

 Autoroute Donald Trump 

 

» nous montre d'ailleurs d'importantes rivalités internationales.


Donald Trump a en effet durant son premier mandat comme président des États‐Unis d'Amérique reconnu le «

 

 Sahara marocain 

 

», territoire considéré pourtant par les Nations Unies comme non autonome et à décoloniser. Le Maroc a de son côté reconnu l'État d'Israël dans la foulée, renforçant la tension avec l'Algérie dont s'est récemment rapproché Pedro Sánchez pour obtenir des hydrocarbures dont le prix a flambé depuis le début des attaques israélo‐américaines en Iran.


Nous essaierons dans notre épisode du 9 octobre prochain d'alerter sur le colloque de l'Observatoire de la Petite Sirène qui doit se tenir le 16 octobre au Palais du Luxembourg à Paris :

https://www.observatoirepetitesirene.org/colloque-2026

. Prétendant soustraire les enfants à l'influence des «

 

idéologies

 

», cet «

 

observatoire

 

» s'oppose surtout aux transitions de genre pour les mineur•e•s.


Sa codirectrice Céline Masson gère aussi le «

 

Réseau de Recherche sur le Racisme et l'Antisémitisme (

RRA

)

 

» qui a fait annuler le colloque «

 

Palestine et Europe : poids du passé et dynamiques contemporaines

 

» qui devait se dérouler au Collège de France en novembre 2025. En avril dernier le Collège de France a également annulé le colloque de l'Observatoire de la Petite Sirène qui s'est donc rabattu sur le Palais du Luxembourg à cause de la sénatrice Jacqueline Eustache-Brinio auteure avec Bruno Retailleau de la proposition de loi sur l'interdiction des transitions de mineur·e·s en 2024.

title: Ataşehir Belediyesine operasyon: Başkan Vekili Murat Güneş dahil 13 kişi gözaltında
content:
Fotoğraf: Ataşehir Belediyesi

İstanbul — Ataşehir Belediyesine yönelik operasyonda Belediye Başkan Vekili Murat Güneş ile 12 kişi gözaltına alındı.

Ataşehir Belediye Başkanı Onursal Adıgüzel’in tutuklanmasının ardından belediye başkan vekilliğine seçilen Murat Güneş, sabah saatlerinde düzenlenen operasyonda gözaltına alındı.

Operasyon kapsamında Güneş ile birlikte 12 kişinin daha gözaltına alındığı bildirildi.

Ataşehir Belediye Başkanı Onursal Adıgüzel, belediyeye yönelik soruşturma kapsamında nisan ayında tutuklanmış ve görevden uzaklaştırılmıştı. Bunun üzerine 30 Nisan’da Belediye Meclisinde başkan vekilliği seçimi yapılmıştı.

CHP’nin adayı Murat Güneş, üçüncü turda 22 oy alarak AKP’nin adayı Serdar Orhan karşısında Ataşehir Belediye Başkan Vekili seçilmişti.

Güneş, CHP listesinden seçilen 6 belediye meclis üyesinin AKP’ye geçmesinin ardından 1 Ekim’de açıklama yapmıştı. Seçmen iradesine yönelik müdahaleleri takip ettiklerini belirten Güneş, “Ataşehir’in geleceğine Ataşehir halkı karar verir. 18 Meclis üyemizle beraber görevimizin başındayız” ifadelerini kullanmıştı.

title: AFAD’da yapılmayan eğitimlere ücret ödemesi: 6 personel hakkında soruşturma izni
content:
Maraş’ta AFAD personelinin okullarda gerçekleştirilmediği belirtilen afet ve deprem farkındalık eğitimlerini yapılmış gibi tutanaklara geçirdiği ve bu belgeler üzerinden personele ücret ödendiği ortaya çıktı.

BirGün’den İlayda Sorku’nun haberine göre, Kahramanmaraş Valiliğinin yaptığı ön incelemenin ardından 6 AFAD personeli hakkında soruşturma izni verildi. İncelemede ayrıca bir satın alma memurunun devlet memuru maaşıyla açıklanamayacağı belirtilen mal varlığı da dosyaya girdi.

Kahramanmaraş Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığına yapılan ihbarın ardından başlatılan incelemede, AFAD personeli Muharrem Yeşilyurt ve Cengiz Göl’ün 2025 yılında fiilen eğitim vermedikleri halde yaklaşık 200 saatlik ders ücreti aldığı ve eğitimlerin gerçekleştirilmiş gibi gösterildiği iddia edildi. İhbarda kamu araçları ve yakıtının kullanımı, mal varlığı, personele baskı ve çeşitli usulsüzlüklere ilişkin iddialar da yer aldı.

Valiliğin ön incelemesinde eğitimlere ilişkin iddiaların bir bölümü doğrulandı. AFAD personelinin 24 Ekim 2025’te Senem Ayşe Anaokulunda acil durum ve deprem farkındalık eğitimi verdiğine dair tutanak hazırlandı. Okul müdürü ise ifadesinde söz konusu eğitimin okulda yapılmadığını belirtti. Kurum yetkilisinin imzası bulunmayan tutanak, Eğitim Şube Müdürü Nurettin Karakoyun tarafından onaylandı ve personele ücret ödendi.

Benzer bir durum Dulkadiroğlu Mehmet Akif Ersoy İlkokulunda da tespit edildi. AFAD personeli, 28 Ekim 2025’te okulda eğitim gerçekleştirildiğine ilişkin tutanak düzenledi. Okul müdürü ise belirtilen tarihte AFAD tarafından herhangi bir eğitim verilmediğini söyledi. Kurum yetkilisinin imzasını taşımayan tutanak onaylanarak ücret ödemesi yapıldı.

İncelemede, ücret ödenen diğer bazı eğitimlere ilişkin tutanaklarda da eğitimin verildiği kurumun yetkilisine ait imzanın bulunmadığı belirlendi.

Valilik, ön inceleme raporu ile dosyada bulunan belgeleri değerlendirdi. Kararda, eğitimlerin verilmiş gibi gösterilmesine ilişkin eylemler açısından Türk Ceza Kanunu’nda düzenlenen “görevi kötüye kullanma” suçunun oluştuğu değerlendirmesi yapıldı.

Eğitim Şube Müdürü Nurettin Karakoyun, Birim Amiri Cengiz Göl, Satın Alma Memuru Muharrem Yeşilyurt, Arama Kurtarma Teknikerleri Burak Erdoğan ve Nuri Yurttaş ile Serhat Toyğun hakkında soruşturma izni verildi.

Ön incelemede Satın Alma Memuru Muharrem Yeşilyurt’un mal bildirim beyannamesi de incelendi. Valilik kararında Yeşilyurt’un “devlet memurluğu maaşı ile açıklanamayacak şekilde taşınır ve taşınmazlar edindiği” belirtildi. Yeşilyurt’un ifadesinde söz konusu mal varlığına ilişkin geçerli bir açıklama yapamadığı kaydedildi.

Valilik, bu durumun memurların yargılanmasını düzenleyen kanun kapsamında olmadığına karar verirken mal varlığının Mal Bildiriminde Bulunulması, Rüşvet ve Yolsuzluklarla Mücadele Kanunu kapsamında değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti. Taşınır ve taşınmazlar ile altın, mücevher, banka ve menkul değerleri, borç ve alacakların incelenmesi amacıyla dosyanın Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığına gönderilmesi uygun bulundu.

Dosyada ayrıca AFAD’a ait veya kiralık araçların amacı dışında kullanıldığı, özel araçlara kamu yakıtı alındığı, TYP personeline yönelik uygunsuz davranışlarda bulunulduğu ve sözleşmeli personele baskı yapıldığı iddiaları da yer aldı. Valilik, bu iddiaları doğrulayacak yeterli bilgi, belge veya tanık ifadesine ulaşılamadığı gerekçesiyle söz konusu başlıklarda soruşturma izni vermedi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Kieler Open Source und Linux Tage
title: Zentral verwaltete MFA für alle Notebooks [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Ein Vortrag von Cornelius Kölbel (NetKnights GmbH / privacyIDEA)


Benutzt Ihr bereits Mehr-Faktor-Authentifizierung in Eurem Unternehmen? Verwaltet Ihr sie zentral? Nur für Zugriffe zu Webseiten?


Oder auch für Windows- und Linux-Notebooks gleichermaßen? Und das auch offline?


Es gibt viele verschiedene technische Verfahren für Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung. Diese basieren auf unterschiedlichen kryptografischen Mechanismen: Mit symmetrischen Schlüsseln, mit asymmetrischen Schlüsseln. Manche funktionieren offline, manche sind schwer zu verwalten, manche lassen sich offline nicht sinnvoll einsetzen.


In diesem Vortrag betrachten wir all diese verschiedenen Authentifizierungsmechanismen - darunter X.509-Zertifikate, OTP und FIDO2 - und gehen auf deren Vor- und Nachteile ein.


Anschließend schauen wir uns an, wie das Open-Source-System zur Verwaltung von Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung "privacyIDEA" verschiedene Möglichkeiten der Offline-Authentifizierung auf Notebooks unter Windows und Linux mit OTP-Token oder FIDO2-Geräten umsetzt.

author: Kieler Open Source und Linux Tage
title: Vom Prompt zum Prozess [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Viele Teams nutzen heute KI über einzelne Chatfenster, verstreute Automationen und proprietäre Tools. Das funktioniert für Experimente, wird aber schnell unübersichtlich: Kontext liegt im falschen System, Workflows sind schwer nachvollziehbar und Unternehmen verlieren die Kontrolle über Modelle, Daten und Infrastruktur.


In diesem Vortrag zeige ich, wie ein offener AI Workspace aufgebaut sein kann, der gesprochene oder geschriebene Arbeitsanweisungen nicht nur beantwortet, sondern sinnvoll verarbeitet: Soll eine Aufgabe direkt ausgeführt werden? Soll der Kontext im richtigen Projektgedächtnis landen? Oder soll daraus ein wiederkehrender Workflow-Entwurf entstehen?


Anhand unseres Open-Source-Projekts Navigator geht es um Architektur, typische Fallstricke und praktische Entscheidungen beim Bau eines AI Workspaces: Modellfreiheit, Projektgedächtnis, Tool-Anbindungen, Workflows, Datenkontrolle und lokale bzw. selbst gehostete Infrastruktur. Ziel ist kein Produktpitch, sondern ein ehrlicher Einblick in die Frage, wie KI im Arbeitsalltag nutzbar wird, ohne neue Abhängigkeiten zu schaffen.

title: Dinge in Debian bewegen: Changelog, Methoden, Lektionen [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Ein Vortrag von Andreas Tille (Debian)


In meinem Vortrag blicke ich auf zwei Jahre als Debian-Projektleiter


zurück und teile die Erfahrungen bei der Koordination eines großen,


globalen Freie-Software-Projekts, das auf ehrenamtlichen Beiträgen und


einer do-okratischen Kultur basiert. Ich werde ein kurzes


"DPL-Changelog" vorstellen: was ich mir ursprünglich vorgenommen hatte,


welche Themen die beiden Jahre geprägt haben und was wir gemeinsam als


Projekt erreichen konnten.


Der Hauptfokus des Vortrags liegt auf Methoden und der täglichen


Projektkoordination. Ich werde erläutern, wie Kommunikation,


Entscheidungsfindung und Zusammenarbeit in der Praxis innerhalb von


Debian funktionieren, einschließlich der Rolle moderner Werkzeuge wie


LLMs in meiner Arbeit als DPL. Statt KI als Lösung an sich darzustellen,


möchte ich praktische Erfahrungen teilen: wo diese Werkzeuge bei der


Kommunikation, der Strukturierung von Informationen oder der Bewältigung


komplexer Aufgaben geholfen haben und wo ihre Grenzen sichtbar wurden.


Der letzte Teil behandelt die gelernten Lektionen aus der Arbeit in


Debians hochgradig verteilten ehrenamtlichen Umfeld. Ich werde


reflektieren, was die Zusammenarbeit erfolgreich macht, wo


Reibungspunkte entstehen können und wie Debian sich an technische und


soziale Veränderungen anpasst, während es seinen Kernwerten treu bleibt.


Ich möchte auch auf nachhaltige Teamstrukturen eingehen - etwa wie das


Debian-Med-Team weiterhin erfolgreich arbeiten konnte, während ich mich


während meiner Amtszeit als DPL zurückzog - sowie auf Debians Tradition


der persönlichen Paketbetreuung und wie diese die Wartung und


Zusammenarbeit im Projekt beeinflusst.

author: Kieler Open Source und Linux Tage
title: Resilient Raspberry Pi OS - der "unkaputtbare" Raspi [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Ein Vortrag von Stefan Baur (X2Go / Open Remote Computing Association - orca e.V.)


Hier geht es um diverse Hard- und Software-Tricks, wie man ein Raspberry Pi OS so installiert, dass es nahezu "unkaputtbar" ist.


Dazu gibt es fertige Installationsskripte für Beispielanwendungen. Einige der Tricks sind gar nicht so neu - aber gefühlt vor über 20 Jahren wieder in Vergessenheit geraten.


Wir beginnen mit der Auswahl eines geeigneten Speichermediums (Spoiler: keine MicroSD-Karten), hangeln uns durch den offiziellen Installer der Raspberry Pi Foundation, und biegen dann mit unserem Installationsskript noch vor dem ersten Start das erstellte Image nach unseren Vorstellungen um.


Dabei nutzen wir Konzepte, die zum Teil noch aus alten, zu OS/2-Zeiten von IBM verfassten Redbooks stammen, aber auch heute auf dem Raspberry Pi noch (oder wieder) von Nutzen sind.


Am Schluss hat man dann zum Beispiel einen kleinen Port-9100-Printserver, mit dem man seinen billigen USB-only-Drucker plötzlich netzwerkfähig machen kann, oder ein mailcow-, paperless-ngx-, oder eurooffice-Demo-Setup (die letztgenannten drei sogar mit Docker), oder die Entwicklungsbasis für Grannophone-Images, oder einen X2Go-Server oder -ThinClient, oder einen WLAN-Accesspoint (oder umgekehrt, einen WLAN-zu-LAN-Adapter für Geräte, die zwingend ein LAN-Kabel als Uplink erwarten) oder einfach nur eine Minimalinstallation, bei der die Eingabe von "sl" dazu führt, dass eine Dampflok als ASCII-Animation über die Konsole huscht, und die man als Basis für eigene Erweiterungen nutzen kann.


Allen diesen Installationsvarianten ist gemein, dass sie einen ungeplanten Stromausfall zumindest soweit problemlos überleben, dass das Betriebssystem danach wieder startet und über SSH erreichbar ist (Services, die lokal Daten speichern müssen, wie z.B. Mailcow, brauchen ggf. manuelle Nacharbeit).


Genauso hat man zu jedem eingespielten Update, wenn man sich an unsere Anleitung hält, immer eine automatisiert (z.B. per watchdog oder Startup-Skript) bzw. aus der Ferne auslösbare Fallback-Möglichkeit auf den vorherigen Stand.


Der finale Clou: Hat man sich sowohl Produktionsumgebung als auch Fallback zerschossen, kommt man mit einem Hardwareschalter beim nächsten Neustart in eine Rettungsumgebung.

title: TELE2, RTÜK lisans bedelini karşılayamadı: Yayınlar sona eriyor
content:
TELE1’e kayyum atanmasının ardından kanaldan ayrılan gazetecilerin kurduğu TELE2 Haber, yaklaşık 11 aylık yayın hayatını sona erdirme kararı aldı.


TELE2 programcısı Murat Taylan, son yayında internet yayınlarını sürdürebilmeleri için Radyo ve Televizyon Üst Kurulu’nun (RTÜK) iki ayrı lisans istediğini, kuruluşun ekonomik koşulları nedeniyle bu bedeli karşılayamadıklarını açıkladı.


Taylan şöyle konuştu:


“Televizyon kanalı kuramıyoruz. RTÜK, biliyorsunuz, TELE2 Haber yayına başladıktan kısa bir süre sonra iki lisans birden istedi bizden. RTÜK’ün önümüze koyduğu lisans talebi 2 milyon lira.”


TELE2’nin kendi içinde de küçülmek zorunda kaldığını söyleyen Taylan, RTÜK’ün tanıdığı yasal sürenin sonuna geldiklerini belirtti:


“İstenen lisans bedelini ödeyemeyeceğimiz için TELE2 Haber adıyla yaptığımız yayınları sonlandırma kararı aldık.” 


Lisans bedeli bir yılda yüzde 80 arttı 


2026’da internet televizyon yayın hizmeti lisansı ve internet üzerinden isteğe bağlı yayın hizmeti lisansı bedeli de 1 milyon 162 bin 306 TL. Her iki lisans da 10 yıllık veriliyor. İkisinin toplamı 2 milyon 324 bin 612 TL.


RTÜK mevzuatına göre internet yayın lisansı bedeli peşin ödenebildiği gibi 10 taksitte de ödenebiliyor.


TELE1’e kayyumdan TELE2’ye


TELE2’nin kapanmasının, kuruluş hikâyesi nedeniyle sıradan bir ekonomik yayın durdurma kararından farklı bir anlamı var. 


TELE1’e 24 Ekim 2025’te kayyum atanmış, Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Merdan Yanardağ ise yürütülen “siyasi casusluk” soruşturması kapsamında 27 Ekim’de tutuklanmıştı. Kayyum yönetiminin ardından kanalın haber programları yayından kaldırılmış ve internet sitesine yeni haber girişi durdurulmuştu. 


TELE 1 kanalına kayyım atandı


24 Ekim 2025


GÜNCELLENİYOR


“Casusluk” İddiasıyla TELE1’e operasyon: Merdan Yanardağ gözaltına alındı


24 Ekim 2025


TELE1’in ekran yüzleri, yöneticileri ve yazarları 31 Ekim’de topluca istifa etti. Ayrılan gazeteciler yaklaşık iki hafta sonra, 14 Kasım’da TELE2’yi kurdu; internet yayınları 15 Kasım’da başladı.


TELE 1 çalışanları istifa etti: Penguen medyası olmayacağız


31 Ekim 2025


Yeni yayın organı böylece TELE1’in kayyum yönetimine geçmesinden sonra gazetecilerin mesleklerini bağımsız biçimde sürdürme girişimi olarak ortaya çıktı.


Ancak internet üzerinden yayın yapmak, televizyon yayıncılığının RTÜK denetiminin dışında kaldığı anlamına gelmiyor. RTÜK mevzuatı internet ortamından radyo, televizyon ve isteğe bağlı yayın yapan kuruluşların ayrı yayın lisansları almasını öngörüyor.


İnternete geçmek mali engeli ortadan kaldırmadı


Gazeteciler TELE1’e kayyum atanmasının ardından geleneksel televizyon kanalından ayrılarak internet üzerinden yayın yapmaya devam etti. Ancak internet yayıncılığı da RTÜK’ün lisans rejimine tabi olduğu için yeni kuruluş yaklaşık 11 ay sonra

2,3 milyon lirayı aşan lisans maliyetiyle

 karşı karşıya kaldı.


TELE2 Haber'e lisans başvurusu ve ücret dayatması: 72 saat içinde erişim engeli gelebilir


15 Nisan 2026


Üstelik ücretlerdeki artış önemli. RTÜK’ün resmi tarifesine göre internet televizyon lisansı 2024’te 643 bin 517 TL iken 2026’da 1 milyon 162 bin 306 TL’ye çıktı. Aynı artış isteğe bağlı internet yayın lisansı için de geçerli.


Bu, iki yılda nominal olarak yaklaşık

yüzde 81 artış

 demek.


Taylan da TELE2’nin karşı karşıya kaldığı tabloyu, yayınların sona erdiğini açıklarken tek cümlede özetledi:


“Televizyon kanalı kuramıyoruz.”


(AEK)

author: Kieler Open Source und Linux Tage
title: Was gibt's neues in Bareos? [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Ein Vortrag von Andreas Rogge (Bareos GmbH & Co. KG)


Dieser Vortrag gibt einen kleinen Überblick über neue Funktionen bzw. größere Änderungen, die in den letzten Jahren ihren Weg in Bareos gefunden haben.


Im Bereich neue Funktionen wird es neben der Unterstützung von Proxmox VE wird es um die verbesserte und erweiterte Unterstützung für das scheinbar unumgängliche Microsoft Ökosystem (Windows Disaster Recovery, Hyper-V, Office 365) gehen.


Erwähnenswerte Veränderungen sind insbesondere die Verbesserungen beim Umgang mit Konfigurationsdateien bei Paketaktualisierungen, die sogenannten automatischen Disk-Autochanger, sowie die Unterstützung von WORM-Medien.


Der Vortrag wurde auf den Kieler Open Source und Linux Tagen im Jahr 2026 gehalten.


Für Inhalt und Richtigkeit sind ausschließlich die jeweiligen Referenten verantwortlich.


Webseite:

https://kielux.de/programm/KOLT26

author: Kieler Open Source und Linux Tage
title: Collabora Office: Grenzenlos plattformübergreifend [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Ein Vortrag von Thorsten Behrens (Collabora Office)


Collabora Office zeigt, dass man für digitale Souveränität nicht auf Funktionsvielfalt verzichten muss.


In diesem Vortrag erzählen wir, wie wir die Lücke zwischen Web, Mobilgeräten und Desktop geschlossen haben, damit unsere Anwender plattformübergreifend ein einheitliches und funktionsreiches Erlebnis erhalten. Wir stellen die neuesten Funktionen vor: darunter unsere native Seitenleiste mit Multi-Modell-KI-Assistent, der kontextbezogen direkt in Dokumenten arbeitet, um Inhalte zusammenzufassen, umzuformulieren und zu generieren, und das stets unter Wahrung der Datensouveränität.


Wir zeigen außerdem, wie einfach sich Collabora Online bereitstellen, warten und skalieren lässt – ganz ohne großen Infrastrukturaufwand. Das Spektrum reicht von einem einzelnen, schlanken „coolwsd“-Dienst direkt auf dem bestehenden Webserver, bis hin zu Kubernetes-Clustern voller leistungsfähiger Document-Worker-Nodes.


Abschließend werfen wir einen Blick auf praxisnahe Integrationen und Implementierungen, darunter den digital souveränen IT-Arbeitsplatz des Bundeslandes Schleswig-Holstein.


Der Vortrag wurde auf den Kieler Open Source und Linux Tagen im Jahr 2026 gehalten.


Für Inhalt und Richtigkeit sind ausschließlich die jeweiligen Referenten verantwortlich.


Webseite:

https://kielux.de/programm/KOLT26

author: Maschinenraum
title: The Power of Modern CSS with Dylan Beattie
content:
In this special episode of Software-Architektur im Stream and

maschinenraum.fm

, host Lucas Dohmen sits down with web development veteran Dylan Beattie to explore the surprising power of modern CSS. Long dismissed as a mere styling tool, CSS has evolved into a robust language for layout, animation, accessibility, and complex interactions — often eliminating the need for heavy JavaScript frameworks. Drawing on decades of experience building for the open web, Dylan shares how combining semantic HTML with contemporary CSS can simplify front-end architecture, reduce dependency on frameworks like React, and help developers ship faster and more maintainably. Tune in to discover how web development is being reimagined.

title: AKP'li Serkan Bayram'dan fon vurgunu çıkışı: "Fatma Betül yesin diye mi?"
content:
AKP İstanbul Milletvekili Serkan Bayram, NOW TV’de katıldığı Çalar Saat programında “fon” soruşturması, adalet sistemi ve belediye başkanlarına yönelik gözaltılar hakkında açıklamalarda bulundu.

Bayram, fon vurgununda adı geçen eski Aile ve Sosyal Politikalar Bakanı ve eski AKP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya’ya yönelik sert ifadeler kullandı.

Engellilerin haklarına ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Bayram, şunları söyledi: “Bir sürü insanın, engelli kardeşlerimizin hakkını elinden aldık. Fatma Betül yesin diye mi? Bir de sosyal politikalara bakıyor. Kimse kusura bakmasın. Herkes bedelini ödesin. Artık içim acıyor.”

Bayram, soruşturmada gündeme gelen para hareketlerinin belgelerle açıklığa kavuşturulması gerektiğini belirterek, “O yatırdı diyor, öbürü yatırmadı diyor” dedi.

Soruşturmanın belirli isimlerle sınırlı kalmaması gerektiğini, AKP ve bürokraside adı geçen kişilere ilişkin iddiaların da araştırılması gerektiğini belirten Bayram, “Genel başkan yardımcıları var deniyor, bürokrasiden kimseler var deniyor, bakan yardımcılardan var deniyor. Kim varsa bunun içinde temizlensin. Partimiz gerçek manada aklansın. Adalette güveni sağlayalım. Adaletin olmadığı bir yerde yatırım olmaz. Yabancıya sermaye gelmez, gelmiyor da kaçıyor” ifadelerini kullandı.

Bayram, son dönemde belediye başkanlarına yönelik operasyonlarda kullanılan gözaltı yöntemini de eleştirerek şunları söyledi; “Yazık, belediye başkanı seçilmiş. Sabah alıyoruz, niye alıyoruz? Çağırsan gelir zaten ya. Bütün belediye başkanlarımız için geçerli bu. Yazıktır, yani bu kadar her şeyi paspas etmeye hiçbirimizin hakkı yok. Net söylüyorum”

title: Hakem Derneği'nin İstanbul şubesinin feshi istemiyle dava açıldı
content:
İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Türkiye Faal Futbol Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği İstanbul Şubesi'nin feshi istemiyle dava açtı.

İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı Yasa Dışı Bahis ve Spor Suçları Soruşturma Bürosu, Türkiye Faal Futbol Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği İstanbul Şubesi'nin feshi istemiyle Asliye Hukuk Mahkemesi'nde dava açtı.

Başsavcılık; dernek yöneticilerinin hakemleri “Yakın, söz dinleyen, kontrol altına alınabilen ve diğerleri” şeklinde tasnif ettiği, maç ve gözlemci görevlendirmelerinde objektif kriterler yerine mensubiyet ve sadakat esaslı hareket edildiği yönünde mesaj ve dokümanlar tespit etti.

Dava dilekçesinde, dernek başkanlığının futbol ve hakemlik camiası üzerinde bir güç unsuru olarak kullanılmaya çalışıldığı, faaliyetlerin dernek tüzüğündeki amaçların dışına çıktığı ve bu uygulamaların süreklilik gösterdiği değerlendirmesine yer verildi. Başsavcılık, Türk Medeni Kanunu’nun 89’uncu maddesi kapsamında derneğin feshine karar verilmesini talep etti.

author: Unknown
title: Batı Şeria'da yılbaşından bu yana işgalci İsraillilerin saldırılarında 30 kişi öldü
content:
Ramallah – İşgal altındaki Batı Şeria'da yılbaşından bu yana Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsraillilerin saldırılarında 30 Filistinlinin hayatını kaybettiği bildirildi.

Filistin Duvar ve Yerleşimlerle Mücadele Heyetinden yapılan açıklamada, 2 Ekim itibarıyla Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsraillilerin saldırılarında ölen Filistinlilerin sayısının 30'a ulaştığı ve bunun 2022'den bu yana kaydedilen yıllık verilerin tamamını aştığı belirtildi.

Ölenlerin 15'inin Ramallah ve El-Bire, 7'sinin Nablus, 3'ünün El-Halil, ikişer kişinin Kudüs ile Selfit ve bir kişinin Kalkily'de hayatını kaybettiği kaydedildi.

Açıklamada, İsrail ordusu ile Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsraillilerin eylülde Filistinlilere, topraklarına ve mülklerine yönelik 2051 saldırı gerçekleştirdiği, bunların 647'sinin Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsrailliler tarafından düzenlendiği aktarıldı.

Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsraillilerin eylüldeki saldırılarında 3 Filistinlinin öldürüldüğü, yılbaşından eylül sonuna kadar ise 5 bin 561 saldırı gerçekleştirdiği belirtildi.

Aynı dönemde Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsraillilerin 9 bin 334'ü zeytin olmak üzere 14 bin 600 ağaca zarar verdiği, İsrail'in de eylülde 89'u mesken olmak üzere 254 Filistin yapısını yıktığı ifade edildi.

İsrail'in Gazze Şeridi'ne saldırılarını başlattığı Ekim 2023'ten bu yana işgal altındaki Batı Şeria ve Doğu Kudüs'te de İsrail askerleri ile Filistin topraklarını gasbeden İsraillilerin, Filistinlilere yönelik baskın ve saldırılarında ciddi artış yaşanıyor.

İsrail, 1967'den bu yana Doğu Kudüs dahil Batı Şeria'yı işgal altında tutuyor. Uluslararası toplum, işgal altındaki Filistin topraklarında kurulan yasa dışı İsrail yerleşimlerini uluslararası hukuk kapsamında yasa dışı kabul ediyor.

Filistin istatistiklerine göre, işgal altındaki Batı Şeria'da 156 yasa dışı yerleşim biriminde ve Yahudi gruplarının kurduğu ve İsrail yasalarına göre de "kaçak" sayılan 360 kaçak yerleşim noktasında Filistin topraklarını gasbeden yaklaşık 750 bin İsrailli bulunuyor. Bunların yaklaşık 250 bini, işgal altındaki Doğu Kudüs'te kurulan 15 yerleşim biriminde yaşıyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Михаил Бакунин - Революционный катехизис
content:
Автор

: Михаил Бакунин

Название

: Революционный катехизис

Дата

: 1866 г.

Источник

: https://ak-protest.narod.ru/revolytkatexiz.htm


 1.

Отрицание наличности действительного, внемирового личного бога,

 а посему и всякого откровения и всякого божественного вмешательства в дела мира и человечества.

Уничтожение служения божеству и его культа.


2.


Заменяя

 культ божества

уваженьем и любовью к человечеству,

 мы провозглашаем:


человеческий разум

 единственным

критерием

 истины,


человеческую совесть

 основой справедливости,


индивидуальную и коллективную свободу

 единственной создательницей порядка в человечестве.


 3.

Свобода

 есть абсолютное право всех взрослых мужчин и женщин не искать чьего-либо разрешения на свои деяния, кроме решения своей собственной совести и своего собственного разума, определяться в своих действиях только своей собственной волей и, следовательно, быть ответственными лишь ближайшим образом перед ними, затем перед обществом, к которому они принадлежат, но лишь постольку, поскольку они дают свое свободное согласие принадлежать к таковому.


 4. Неправда, что свобода одного гражданина ограничивается свободой всех остальных. Человек действительно свободен лишь в той мере, в какой его свободно признанная свободной совестью всех остальных и как в зеркале в нем отражающаяся и излучающаяся из него свобода находит в свободе других подтверждение и расширение в бесконечность. Человек действительно свободен только среди равным образом свободных людей, и так как он свободен лишь в своем качестве человека, то рабство хотя бы одного-единственного человека на земле является как нарушение самого принципа человечности, отрицанием свободы всех.


 5.

Свобода

 каждого может, таким образом, найти осуществление только при равенстве всех. Осуществление свободы в правовом и фактическом равенстве является

справедливость.


 6. Существует только один-единственный догмат, один-единственный закон, одна-единственная моральная основа для людей —

свобода.

 Уважать свободу ближнего есть

обязанность;

 любить его, служить ему есть

добродетель.


 7.

Безусловное исключение всякого принципа авторитета и государственной необходимости.


Человеческое общество,

 которое при своем зарождении было естественным фактом, предшествовавшим свободе и пробуждению человеческой мысли, и позднее стало религиозным фактом, организованным по принципу божественного и человеческого авторитета, должно сегодня получить новый образ на основе свободы, которая отныне должна стать единственным образующим принципом его политической и экономической организации.

Порядок в обществе должен быть равнодействующей всех местных, коллективных и индивидуальных свобод, достигших возможно высшей степени развития.


 8. Следовательно, политическая и экономическая организация социальной жизни не должна более, как это имело место до сих пор, исходить сверху вниз и от центра к периферии, по принципу единства и вынужденной централизации, но

снизу вверх и от периферии к центру,

 по принципу свободной ассоциации и федерации.


 9.

Политическая организация.

 Невозможно установить конкретное, всеобщее и обязательное правило для внутреннего развития и политической организации наций, ибо существование каждой отдельной нации подчинено множеству различных исторических, географических и экономических условий, которые не позволяют установить образец организации, равно подходящий и приемлемый для всех. Такое, безусловно лишенное всякой практической полезности предприятие было бы, впрочем, вторжением в богатство и непосредственность жизни, которая любит бесконечное разнообразие, и, что имеет еще большее значение, стало бы в противоречие с самим принципом свободы.

Но все же имеются существенные, абсолютные условия,

 вне которых практическое осуществление и организация свободы будут всегда невозможны.


 Эти условия следующие:


 a)

Радикальная отмена всякой официальной религии и всякой привилегированной или даже только охраняемой, оплачиваемой и поддерживаемой государством церкви.

 Безусловная свобода совести и пропаганды для каждого с неограниченной возможностью для каждого воздвигать своим богам, каковы бы они ни были, сколько ему угодно храмов и оплачивать и содержать священников своей религии.

author: Daron Letts
title: Iqaluit Northmart unveils completed in-store renovations
content:
Three years of continuous in-store renovations at Iqaluit’s Northmart are finally complete, an accomplishment marked by a grand opening Friday morning.


The event, which featured speeches, prizes and giveaways, attracted dozens of customers who lined up outside waiting for the store to open at 9 a.m.


Northmart deli worker Tim Gresiuk stops to greet Pebbles the puppy, cradled by customer Mia Manning on Friday morning. Manning said she is impressed with the store’s new deli. (Photo by Daron Letts)


“I love it,” said shopper Lena Takoonagak, adding that she had stayed away from the store for three years to avoid the construction.

“Now when you come in here you feel like you’re down south.”


New additions since the store hosted a

soft opening

 in January include a spacious furniture display that’s equipped with a digital catalog.


There are new and wider checkout stations, a brand-name clothing section, and a refurbished KFC and Tim Hortons takeout restaurant, among other features.


Customer Anukiruaq Sageaktook expressed relief that renovations are finally finished.


“It took awhile,” he said. “It was awful. We couldn’t find anything. Now everything seems to be back in place.”


Store staff shared their customers’ sentiments.


“It’s so nice to finally be done,” said Byron Whissell, who started as a bakery manager five years ago and is now a senior manager. “Helping customers through the transition was a challenge.”


Staff were tasked with continually moving equipment and switching products between aisles, while cleaning off construction dust along the way, he said.


On the positive side, Whissell said he learned a lot of customers’ names as he shepherded them through the store.


That phase is over, said Jim Caldwell, Winnipeg-based president of Canadian retail operations with the chain’s parent corporation, the North West Co.


“It’s a grand new beginning,” he said.


Still, while the interior is complete, the company plans to grade the parking lot next summer, he added.


The recent renovations have been in the works since 2018, the year the store’s warehouse was destroyed by fire, said Laura Broesky, manager of space planning.


The COVID-19 pandemic delayed the rebuilding of the warehouse, but it was completed in 2024. The recent renovations allow more space for furniture displays,

said a North West Co. vice-president Mike Beaulieu.


The store hired 77 new staff during the renovations, increasing its workforce to 257 mostly full-time positions. New hires include 18 workers in the KFC and 24 in the new deli.


Subcontractors such as K.R.T. Electrical Ltd., Nunavut Excavating and Baffin Building Systems employed approximately 60 local workers.


Dominix Fire Protection and Services installed the sprinkler system after it finished similar work for the store’s warehouse in 2024, said owner Dean Dominix.


“It was long. The whole project was well over a year,” he said, adding that three Inuit workers helped.


Northmart assistant manager Jibran Khan welcomes customers to the Iqaluit store Friday morning, as customer Jutanie Ishulutak enjoys a candy apple near the entrance. (Photo by Daron Letts)


The store’s facade also transformed. It now features a metal mural based on the work of Puvirnituq artist Juanisialuk Irqumia,

Hunting Walrus by Kayak

.


A large sign above the entrance proclaims “serving Iqaluit since 1914.”


That date refers to the Hudson’s Bay Co.’s early retail trade in the community, Beaulieu said.


According to North West’s website, the two corporations’ histories converged in 1987, when a group of investors, including 415 employees, purchased Hudson’s Bay Company’s Northern Stores Division and its

178 locations, many of which originated as early trading posts.


In 1990 the company rebranded as the North West Co

.

title: FORMATION PSYCHO TRAUMA SPAAM
content:
Le SPAAM (Soutien Psycho-émotionnel Antirep et Auti-défense Marseille) propose une formation d'une journée autour du psychotrauma !


samedi 17 octobre, 9h30 - 17h30


Marseille chutes la vie


sur inscription : spaam13@riseup.net


Le SPAAM propose une formation d'une journée autour du psychotrauma.


Le matin, on va vous présenter c'est quoi le psychotrauma en essayant d'être assez


précis, et l'après-midi on va plus se concentrer sur qu'est ce qu'on en fait, les outils et


tout pour vivre avec/prévenir. Y aura un peu des parties interactives, mais aussi des


parties un théorique et descendantes où on va vous donner beaucoup d'info, désolé.e.s si c'est chiant


on va faire au mieux.


On souhaite rendre le soin politique et appropriable par toustes, sans le laisser aux pros

que proches. On voit bien que beaucoup de gentes y sont confronté.e.s de manière

être plus facilement cible de situations traumatisantes (agressions, confrontation avec

title: 1er jour d'octobre et ça pète fort à Marseille !
content:
Récit subjectif de la mobilisation à Marseille. Les lycéen.nes s'organisent pour demander plus de dignité, des moyens qui permettent une égalité des chances, la suppression de Parcoursup. Ca bouge dans la rue pour bousculer l'Etat macroniste, les facho, et ce monde capitaliste qui nous déprime !


Les lycées se mobilisent. Déjà au printemps dernier c'était le cas, contre la militarisation de la jeunesse, etc


Et là fin septembre ça rebouge, en Seine St denis d'abord puis dans toute la france. A marseille c'était plutôt tranquille, mais les flics se sont vite énervés à Martigues, à arles, à salon de provence.


La grosse journée ça sera jeudi 1er octobre. Des blocages partout. Déterminés. Malgré la violence de la police, plus d'une dizaine d'arrestations. Après les blocages de lycées le matin, tout le monde se retrouve devant le comico de Noailles à midi, puis à Réformés pour bloquer le carrefour l'après midi, avant d'aller au rassemblement appelé par les syndicats à 17h préfecture.


La ville est à pieds, parce que la RTM a exercé son droit de retrait après le détournement puis l'incendie d'un bus devant un lycée. Un service de transport gratuit se transformant en barricade. Les pompiers perdront aussi un camion. Vous avez du voir ça en boucle dans les médias. Vous avez sûrement moins vu les charges policières, les tirs de LBD 40 sur les enfants, les flics en civil la BAC chasser du jeune la matraque téléscopique à la main ou directement au volant de leur berline banalisé gazeuse par la fenêtre… et vous avez sûrement moins entendu les revendications pour plus de moyen à l'école pour une vraie égalité des chances, la demande de supprimer le dispositif discriminant de Parcoursup, vouloir un avenir autre que militaire et chair à canon du capitalisme… Ca s'organise et ça bouge de partout.


cidessous lycée victor hugo bloquépar les flics qui ont repoussé et nassé les lycéens dans la gare st charles. et le lycée nord où flic et pompier sont venus imposer l'ordre et la résignation.


Vendredi 2 octobre la préfecture et les proviseurs ont décidé de fermer tous les lycée, faire les cours en présentiel ce que certains prof ont refusé. Et donc ça continue à bloquer par endroits mais c'est aussi le temps de faire une assemblée par ci, une par là, réunissant lycéen.ne.s, profs, aed, parents, soutiens, etc. La préfecture a aussi pondu de nouveaux arrêté interdisant tout rassemblement. L'État fait la sourde oreille et sort le flingue : 2000 arrestations, des flics qui tapent fort, des instructions données aux procureurs pour punir et apeurer, et les médias qui font leur travail de mange-merde « ouin ouin poubelle brûlée casseur venu de l'extérieur les sauvages ». Luttons contre ces réactionnaires et toujours leurs mêmes armes de la division, de la stigmatisation raciste.


Notre colère est légitime !


On répond comme on peut à la violence de l'État !

title: #you would think those 6 syllable words were being taken away
content:
queeranarchism

:

A lot of people become insufferable when you point out that

“You need to learn a dozen new 6-syllable words derived from Greek to participate in our conversation”

and

“our entire community is white college-graduates and all our efforts to diversify have failed”

constantly overlap for really obvious reasons.


#you would think those 6 syllable words were being taken away

Well, yes, kinda. I’m not cancelling words but I am challenging people to think of possible easier words.

If the best thing we can come up with for “stop doing man/woman and cis/trans binaries!” is ‘exorsexism’, we’re shit at accessible communication. Sorry, not sorry.

If the Germans can call combined oral contraceptives 'anti-baby-pills’, then we can decide to come up with simpler, more intuitive and easier-to-remember words for the concepts that we want a lot of people of all backgrounds to understand.

Αναλυτικά:


Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στους Ινδούς πολιτικούς κρατούμενους, 12.00, στα Προπύλαια


Καλεί η

Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης στον Ινδικό Λαό:


Συγκέντρωση: Λευτεριά στους ινδούς πολιτικούς κρατούμενους


Θανατική ποινή στους ινδούς φασίστες, όχι στους 10 αγωνιστές!


Αλληλεγγύη στο Κ.Κ. Ινδίας (Μαοϊκό)!


Όχι στον άξονα Ελλάδας-«Ισραήλ»-Ινδίας!


2013. O Λαϊκός Πόλεμος στην Ινδία σε πλήρη εξέλιξη, με τις μαχήτριες και τους μαχητές του Λαϊκού Απελευθερωτικού Αντάρτικου Στρατού να δρουν επισήμως σε 106 περιφέρειες της Ινδίας.


Αδυνατώντας να κάμψουν το επαναστατικό κίνημα της χώρας, διάφορες πολιτειακές κυβερνήσεις, σε συντονισμό με την κεντρική στο Δελχί, ιδρύουν ταγματασφαλίτικες μονάδες, σε περιοχές όπου οι στρατιωτικές και παραστρατιωτικές μονάδες εφαρμόζουν πολιτική καμένης γης, προκειμένου να παραδώσουν πλούσιο υπέδαφος, νερά και δάση χωρίς τους αυτόχθονες κατοίκους τους στους διεθνείς επιχειρηματικούς ομίλους και τους ντόπιους μεταπράτες. Εν μέσω μαζικών σφαγών, τα καθεστωτικά κόμματα έχουν το θράσος να κάνουν προεκλογική εκστρατεία σε αυτές ακριβώς τις περιοχές. Καθοδηγούμενος από το ΚΚΙ (Μαοϊκό), ο Λαϊκός Απελευθερωτικός Αντάρτικος Στρατός, στις 25/5/2013, δίνει ένα μάθημα στο καθεστώς στην περιοχή Τζιράμ Γκάτι στην περιφέρεια Σούκμα της πολιτείας Τσατίσγκαρχ. Μεταξύ των 28 νεκρών, ο Μαχέντρα Κάρμα, εμπνευστής της δημιουργίας των διαβόητων ταγματασφαλιτών «Σάλβα Τζουντούμ», καθώς και άλλα στελέχη του τότε κυβερνητικού Ινδικού Κογκρέσου. Ο λαός της περιοχής ανασαίνει και διατρανώνει τη χαρά του.


2026. Ο Λαϊκός Απελευθερωτικός Αντάρτικος Στρατός έχει υποχωρήσει δραματικά. Ήδη από το Μάρτη, ο υπουργός Εσωτερικών του καθεστώτος Αμίτ Σαχ δηλώνει ότι η Ινδία «απαλλάχτηκε από ναξαλίτες». Το επαναστατικό κίνημα στην Ινδία βρίσκεται σε κρίση. Όμως, όπως ανέφερε και ο πρωθυπουργός Μόντι στην επέτειο «ανεξαρτησίας» της Ινδίας στις 15/8, στόχος πια είναι οι «πνευματικά ναξαλίτες». Το κυνήγι μαγισσών, που έχει ξεκινήσει εδώ και χρόνια, εντείνεται, αφού το επαναστατικό κίνημα κατάφερε, στο μεταξύ, να μην περιοριστεί στα δάση, αλλά να συνδεθεί με τις πόλεις.


Όλοι γνωρίζουν πως, παρά τη στρατιωτική υποχώρηση, το επαναστατικό κίνημα, με επικεφαλής το ΚΚΙ (Μαοϊκό), αποτελεί την πραγματική εναλλακτική για τη χώρα. Γι’ αυτό, όλοι γνωρίζουν πως η θανατική ποινή στην οποία καταδικάστηκαν στις 16/9 10 ήδη από το 2013 φυλακισμένοι για την επίθεση στο Τζιράμ Γκάτι, δεν θα περιοριστεί σε αυτούς. Ήδη, άλλωστε, δολοφονούνται εξωδικαστικά, σαπίζουν στις φυλακές, βιάζονται, ξυλοκοπούνται και διαπομπεύονται όχι μόνο «ναξαλίτες», αλλά και γυναίκες, μουσουλμάνοι, αγωνιζόμενοι αγρότες και εργάτες, ακτιβιστές των ανθρωπίνων δικαιωμάτων, μέλη καταπιεζόμενων καστών και εθνοτήτων, απλοί δημοκράτες. Μόνο μεταξύ 2014-2024, είχαν γίνει 19.868 συλλήψεις βάσει του διαβόητου «αντιτρομοκρατικού» νόμου UAPA (2024: 2.145), με τις «δίκες» να γίνονται με το σταγονόμετρο. 180 άμαχοι Αντιβάσι δολοφονήθηκαν το 2024 και 450 το πρώτο μισό του 2025 από το ινδικό κράτος στον πόλεμο που κήρυξε ενάντια στον ίδιο το λαό του. Κάθε 71 δευτερόλεπτα διαπράττεται ένα καταγεγραμμένο έγκλημα σε βάρος ινδών γυναικών (επίσημα στοιχεία NCRB, 2024). Αυτή είναι η Ινδία, «η μεγαλύτερη δημοκρατία στον κόσμο», σύμμαχος – ποιου άλλου; – των σιωναζί και των ελλήνων αστών στον φιλοπόλεμο άξονα που δημιουργούν.

author: Chris Walker
title: Dem Candidate Sends “Cease and Desist” Order to Republican Over Deepfake Ads
content:
Democrat Rebecca Cooke said the deepfakes produced by GOP Rep. Derrick Van Orden “undermine our democratic process.”

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

This week, Rebecca Cooke, the Democratic candidate for a House of Representatives race in western Wisconsin, sent a “cease and desist” order to her Republican opponent, Rep. Derrick Van Orden, due to his constant use of artificial intelligence (AI) generated “deepfakes” featuring her likeness.

The ads depict Cooke in fictional situations, including a conversation with former President Joe Biden in which he says that he plans to “take advantage of as much corruption as possible.”

Cooke posted a copy of the letter sent to Van Orden on social media, stating that “he’s been using AI to put words in my mouth because he has nothing else to run on.”

“These defamatory, misleading videos undermine our democratic process and are the exact kind of mudslinging voters are tired of,” Cooke added.

A letter sent by Elias Law Group on behalf of Cooke condemns Van Orden’s actions further, noting that, “at this fulcrum in American history, communities are fighting against the AI data centers that have been crammed down their throats.” The letter also states that Wisconsin law prohibits using deepfake videos in political messaging, but that Van Orden’s campaign is running online ads through a loophole that “does not apply to federal candidates.”

“You are violating the spirit of the law,” the letter adds.

🚨 NEW: I've sent a cease and desist to Derrick Van Orden over the AI slop deepfakes he continues to post of me. He's been using AI to put words in my mouth because he has nothing else to run on. These defamatory, misleading videos undermine our democratic process and are the… pic.twitter.com/ttdtVTxfBJ

In response to the letter, Van Orden shared yet another AI-generated video. Though the post did not depict Cooke directly, the statement made by the main character — a duck — was clearly intended to be a portrayal of her complaining about his false ads.

The race between Cooke and Van Orden is hotly contested, one of many that could feature a “flip” in favor of Democrats in this year’s midterm election. Polls have consistently shown Cooke slightly ahead of Van Orden, with a survey in June revealing she was four points ahead of him at that time.

Beyond being a loyalist of President Donald Trump, Van Orden has a troubling history. In a book he published in 2015, he bragged about exposing an unwilling patient’s testicles to women he was training as a military medic. In 2021, he harassed a teenage worker at a library in his district over the display of LGBTQ books, with that employee describing him as “aggressive” and “loud,” engaging in “full-on shouting” as he shoved books around the display.

Notably, Van Orden was among hundreds present at the U.S. Capitol building on January 6, 2021. Although there isn’t evidence that he engaged in acts of violence that day, Van Orden was there in support of Trump’s efforts to overturn the 2020 election, and has continued to peddle lies about fraud in that year’s race. The Republican lawmaker has also lied about his presence on the building’s grounds that day.

Van Orden is not alone in promoting AI deepfakes to attack his opponents, as myriad conservative candidates have done so this election cycle. Ads by these politicians have included falsely depicting candidates they’re running against as driving undocumented immigrants to vote, grabbing bags of money, and holding hands with other politicians to suggest they were in a romantic “throuple.”

Critics have decried these types of ads as “slopaganda,” a combination of the terms “AI slop” and “propaganda.” Experts have warned that these types of ads could become more commonplace in future political races.

As Trump cracks down on political speech, independent media is increasingly necessary.

author: Sam Rosenthal
title: Progressives Saw Wins in DNC, But Battle for the Future of the Party Continues
content:
Resolutions calling to abolish ICE and pushing to block arms sales are laying a progressive groundwork for 2028.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

This summer, attendees who were punctual enough to make it into the 9:00 am Democratic National Committee’s (DNC) resolutions meeting at its August convening in Texas were treated to an unusual display: In a humdrum corner of the Austin Marriott Downtown, the DNC resolutions committee voted to abolish Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). And, in a move that went against the DNC’s habit of blocking any resolution viewed as critical of Israel, the committee also voted to reaffirm its commitment to the Leahy Laws, which bar the U.S. government from supplying weapons to governments violating human rights abroad.

The resolutions committee is largely known for bland resolutions with titles like “Resolution Recognizing the Work and Contributions of the California Young Democrats” or “Resolution Reclaiming the American Promise.” That is, they are statements, sometimes grand and sometimes small, that are meant to be read as aspirational; paragraphs devoted to nice-to-haves in a world where Democrats could wave a magic wand and make it just-so.

Recently, though, the DNC resolutions committee has become a site of contention between the party’s corporate-friendly establishment and its progressive wing. While some left-leaning activists have contested the party establishment’s power in Democratic primaries around the country, others have advanced on the DNC itself in a quest to reform the party apparatus to be more accommodating toward (and maybe even supportive of) progressive policy.

This tension was on full display at this year’s summer meeting in Austin, Texas. Progressive DNC members, many of whom have organized in ad hoc formations for years within the DNC, put forward two measures intended to put the party on the record about two of the biggest hot-button issues for progressives today: the genocide in Gaza and abolishing ICE.

This was not the first time that progressives have advanced resolutions to address these issues. In recent sessions, DNC members have introduced resolutions explicitly calling for an end to AIPAC funding in Democratic primaries and resolutions calling for conditions on military aid to Israel. These, however, have routinely failed to secure enough votes on the resolutions committee, and have occasionally been blocked or procedurally undermined by DNC Chair Ken Martin.

Resolutions condemning the U.S.-Israel relationship have been especially opposed by the DNC’s establishment-friendly majority. A year ago, at the DNC’s 2025 summer meeting, the resolutions committee blocked a measure that would have called for an arms embargo against Israel, opting instead for a watered-down alternative pushed by Martin that called only for unrestricted humanitarian aid into Gaza and a vague commitment to a two-state solution.

Progressive DNC members put forward two measures intended to put the party on the record about two of the biggest hot-button issues for progressives today: the genocide in Gaza and abolishing ICE.

In that instance, Martin used a maneuver that he has deployed more than once to frustrate progressive activists’ attempts to pass more left-leaning resolutions: He authored and introduced a resolution that appeared to address the same issue, but which committed the DNC to a substantially less radical course of action than the original resolution. Martin’s resolution was agendized earlier in the committee meeting and passed by unanimous consent. Then, when the more radical resolution came up for a vote, committee members rebuked the body for taking up an issue that had already been addressed by Martin’s resolution, even though the two committed the DNC to very different courses of action.

Progressive victories during this summer’s meeting in Austin were all the more remarkable because Martin again leaned on this tactic, but unsuccessfully. A “Resolution Condemning the Trump Administration’s Reckless and Deadly Approach to Immigration Enforcement” was the third agendized item in the resolutions committee and was passed again by a unanimous voice vote. This resolution, notably, stopped short of calling for a permanent end to ICE.
