title: Эррико Малатеста - Ещё о «Науке и Анархии». Необходимость и свобода
content:
Автор

: Эррико Малатеста

Название

: Ещё о «Науке и Анархии». Необходимость и свобода

Дата

: 1 февраля 1926

Источник

: Pensiero e Volontà год 3й, №2


Ещё о «Науке и Анархии».

Необходимость и свобода


 Замечания, которые я здесь и там писал в последнее время об отношениях между Наукой и Анархией, и особенно тот факт, что я назвал абсурдным определение, которое Кропоткин давал Анархии – «

Анархия есть миросозерцание, основанное на механическом понимании явлений, охватывающее всю природу, включая сюда и жизнь человеческих обществ

», – возмутили некоторых товарищей, которые, не понимая, конечно, по моей вине, того, что я имел в виду, заставили меня сказать, будто анархизм не знал, что делать с наукой и философией, и пустились доказывать великие заслуги науки и утверждать, что анархизм есть общая концепция жизни, то есть философия, так и не коснувшись вовсе того пункта, который я действительно поставил на обсуждение.


 Постараюсь объясниться яснее.


 Оставим философию, которой дают тысячу разных определений и которая часто поистине есть, как иронически говорит один философ, сам не блистающий чрезмерной ясностью, искусство делать туманным то, что ясно. Я профан и потому, эмпирически, для личного пользования, делю то, что говорят «философы», на две части: то, что я понимаю, и то, что я не понимаю. В той части, которую я понимаю, я нахожу истины, ошибки, сомнения, гипотезы, проблемы – всё вещи в высшей степени интересные, но которые в конечном счёте все входят в область научного исследования, если среди наук включать логику и психологию. В той части, которую я не понимаю, мне чудится видеть фантазии, тавтологии, споры о словах... но поскольку я не понимаю, будет разумнее воздержаться от суждений.


 Останемся на твёрдой почве науки.


 Цель научного исследования – изучать природу, открывать факт и «законы», которые им управляют, то есть условия, при которых факт

необходимо

 происходит и

необходимо

 воспроизводится. Наука составляется тогда, когда может предвидеть то, что произойдёт, – неважно, умеет ли она или нет сказать, почему: если прогноз не сбывается, это значит, что была ошибка и потому нет нужды делать более широкое и более глубокое исследование, чтобы спасти прогноз

[1]

. Случай, произвол, каприз – понятия, чуждые науке, которая ищет то, что фатально, то есть то, что не может быть иначе, то, что необходимо.


 Эта необходимость, связывающая между собой во времени и пространстве все естественные факты и составляющая задачу науки – искать и открывать, – охватывает ли она всё, что происходит во вселенной, включая психические и социальные факты?


 Механицисты говорят «да» и думают, что всё подчинено одному и тому же механическому закону, всё предопределено физико-химическими предшествующими причинами: и ход светил, и рост цветка, и трепет влюблённого, и развитие человеческой истории. И система, охотно соглашусь, представляется прекрасной и грандиозной, менее абсурдной, менее непостижимой, чем метафизические системы, и, если бы её можно было доказать как истинную, она полностью удовлетворяла бы ум. Но тогда, несмотря на все псевдологические усилия детерминистов примирить систему с жизнью и с моральным чувством, не остаётся места – ни малого, ни большого, ни условного, ни безусловного – для воли и для свободы. Наша жизнь и жизнь человеческих обществ была бы вся предопределена и предвидима,

ab eterno

 и навечно, во всех мельчайших подробностях, как и любой механический факт, и наша воля была бы простой иллюзией, как та иллюзия камня, о котором говорит Спиноза, – будто, падая, он сознавал своё падение и верил, что падает, потому что хочет падать.


 Допустив это, – а механицисты и детерминисты не могут не допустить этого, не противореча себе, – становится абсурдным желание контролировать свою жизнь, желание воспитывать себя и других, желание изменить в том или ином смысле общественную организацию. Вся эта суета людей, готовящих лучшее будущее, была бы бесполезным плодом иллюзии и не могла бы продолжаться после того, как обнаружилось, что это иллюзия. Правда, и иллюзия, и абсурд были бы фатальными продуктами механических функций мозга и как таковые входили бы в систему. Но, ещё раз, какое место остаётся для воли, для свободы, для действенности человеческого труда в жизни и в судьбах человека?


 Чтобы у людей была уверенность или по крайней мере надежда, что они могут делать полезное дело, нужно допустить творческую силу, первопричину или первопричины, независимые от физического мира и от механических …

title: Los jueces de la Corte fueron escrachados en San Martín de los Andes
content:
Organizaciones sindicales, vecinos y vecinas de San Martín de Los Andes, junto a espacios políticos se movilizaron a las puertas del hotel donde se desarrolla el 26° Congreso de Funcionarios de Tribunales Orales Federales. En el lugar se encontraban los jueces de la Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Nación Horacio Rosatti, Carlos Rosenkrantz y Ricardo Lorenzetti.


Escuchar el reporte de Laura Cotescu Fm Pocahullo de San Martín de los Andes


La Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Nación revocó el martes el fallo que había declarado la inconstitucionalidad del artículo 154 del DNU 70/23, el cual derogaba la Ley de Tierras Rurales. La sentencia fue firmada por los jueces.


La Asociación Trabajadores del Estado (ATE) convocó a la movilización para escrachar a los jueces en el centro de San Martín de Los Andes.


“Estos tres tipos son unos cobardes, no los tenemos que dejar caminar por la calle. No los votó nadie y sin embargo están entregando la soberanía sobre la tierra que es de todos los argentinos”, reclamó Rodolfo Aguiar, Secretario General de ATE.


URGENTE!! AHORA!!


ATE ESCRACHA A LOS JUECES DE LA CORTE SUPREMA EN SAN MARTÍN DE LOS ANDES!!


En este momento el sindicato protesta en el Hotel Le Village donde se encuentran Rosatti, Rosenkrantz y Lorenzetti.

Estos tipos designados por decreto usurparon el Poder Judicial.

Son…

pic.twitter.com/L9Aqd3xfOv


— Rodolfo Aguiar (@rodoaguiar)

October 1, 2026


La presencia de los jueces también causó la indignación de los vecinos de la ciudad patagónica que se hicieron presentes en las puertas del céntrico hotel.


Con cantos, carteles por la soberanía argentina, y arrojando papel higiénico hacia el edificio, los manifestantes hicieron oír su mensaje.


“Me parece un privilegio que al día siguiente de que se anule el fallo, estén en nuestro pueblo”, denunció una vecina en la movilización.


.En diálogo con Fm Pocahullo remarcó: “Sabiendo lo que pasó el 6 de agosto, con toda la movilización popular, a menos de dos meses de que pasó eso, andan por la calle lo más tranquilos”.

author: David Swanson
title: World BEYOND War Asia Celebrated the International Day of Peace
content:
By Jhay de Jesus, World BEYOND War, October 2, 2026


2026 marks the 45th year since the United Nations established the International Day of Peace. It is ironic that while this year’s theme is “

Invest in Peace – For Everyone, Everywhere, Every Day,

” we are witnessing continuous attacks in different nations, ongoing genocide against innocent people, especially children, and the occupation of lands and territories.


World BEYOND War

 continues to vow to work for the abolition of wars and the establishment of a just and sustainable peace system in the world.


This year, as we commemorate the day of peace,

World BEYOND War Asia

 partnered with several organizations and institutions to conduct two major events. With the help of movements and academic institutions like

Kilusan para sa Pambansang Demokrasya (KILUSAN)

,

PEACE Philippines

, and the

Philippine Normal University (PNU)

, we held symbolic actions depicting our advocacy for peace and our opposition to war and militarism.


Peace Umbrellas


Entitled “

PEACE Umbrellas: Shield against Continuous Rain of War and Militarism

,” World BEYOND War Asia, KILUSAN and its member organizations gathered at the Bantayog ng mga Bayani (Heroes’ Memorial) in Quezon City, Philippines, to hold white umbrellas bearing various calls such as “Free Palestine,” “Peace Not War,” “Reject Pax Silica,” and other anti-militarism and pro-peace demands. Five larger umbrellas spelled out “PEACE” to highlight the main call of the event.


The venue, Bantayog ng mga Bayani, is significant because its walls of remembrance bear the names of many anti-Martial Law activists who fought during the dark days of the regime of former dictator Ferdinand Marcos Sr. The International Day of Peace also fell on the exact date when the former dictator declared Martial Law, a 14-year period that resulted in atrocities including abductions, incarcerations, killings, massacres, torture, and the displacement of communities.


Umbrellas also hold special significance as the country continues to face massive flooding due to a lack of government response to natural disasters like typhoons. For a year now, Filipinos have used umbrellas in protests to remind everyone of the effects of typhoons and monsoon rains flooding our communities, while government officials swim in millions of pesos diverted through corruption in flood-control projects. Now, as the country strengthens its ties with the U.S. and pawns the nation to continuous war games, the people hope to shield themselves from further atrocities this partnership will bring to the Philippines and its citizens.


Kite-Flying and Conversations of Peace


To conclude the International Day of Peace week, WBW Asia partnered with the Philippine Normal University (PNU) and PEACE Philippines to host an event dubbed “

PEACE UP! Sending our Messages of Peace High Up for the World to See

,” hosted at PNU in Manila City, Philippines


Attended by over 200 students, faculty members, and representatives from several student and thematic (off-campus) organizations, the event focused on the overarching call for global peace. Before the actual kite-flying activity, we held a conversation on peace featuring stories from various individuals and organizations.


We were fortunate to have with us Dr. Swee-Hin Toh, the 2000 UNESCO Peace Education Laureate, and Mahadia Abu Dalal, a Filipino-Palestinian educator and refugee based in a province in Southern Luzon. Dr. Toh shared how they have tirelessly worked in peace education even as the world continues to suffer from war and militarism, how the vision of peace inspires young people to join the advocacy, and the lessons learned from decades of peace education.


Mahadia shared how recent attacks in Palestine have affected their lives, creating refugees and tearing families apart. As an educator, she emphasized the importance of continuous conversations to share stories from the ground, ensure they are heard, and find ways to improve difficult situations.


We also heard a response from the PNU student body, represented by Christine (Luna) Zonio, a student in the Social Sciences program. She called on everyone to get involved in efforts to end U.S. imperialistic wars and militarism. Luna also stressed that partnerships and agreements like those the U.S. and the Philippines continue to enter into must be rejected, as they pose greater threats and place communities in serious danger.

author: Veridiana Alimonti
title: Ola Bini Ordered to Leave Ecuador Under Obscure Accusations
content:
In a new blow to

Ola Bini’s

 legal guarantees, Ecuadorean authorities retained the free software developer and security expert yesterday in Quito and ordered his immediate deportation from the country. He is barred from returning to Ecuador for 10 years.

 


According to

information released

 by his lawyer, Bini was intercepted by a car with four people who identified themselves as immigration agents. He was then taken to an immigration office without further information or a formal order from a competent authority. There, officials told Bini that his visa had been revoked but didn’t show any supporting document.

 


Bini's defense

filed

 a

habeas corpus

 to safeguard his freedom and prevent his deportation. Yet, Ecuadorian authorities affirmed that the developer represents a threat or risk to public security and the state structure, and must leave the country. The ground for deportation is

a secret report

 which allegedly asserts that Bini committed acts against the security of Ecuador. The defense could not access its contents.

 


The deportation hearing started yesterday at 5pm Quito time. Human rights organizations tried to attend the hearing but were

denied entry

. The hearing was suspended but later reinstalled establishing his immediate deportation. Ola Bini was relocated to Quito's airport and must stay there until fly back to Sweden.

 


The case that led to Bini's

unfounded criminal conviction

 has expired (the statute of limitations ran out) and the court had already formally lifted all precautionary measures against him

. Yesterday's e

vents open a new chapter in the nefarious persecution of Ola Bini by Ecuadorean authorities.

 


Since Bini’s arbitrary arrest in 2019, EFF

has reported

 about his criminal prosecution fraught with misconceptions and rights violations. The script of what happened yesterday follows the same patterns we saw in the entire case, from its outset with unjustified allegations that Bini was a national security risk. The Observation Mission of Ola Bini’s case, joined by EFF and other digital and human rights organizations, has published

reports

 and

raised international awarenness

 about the perils of this case to the protection of rights online and the beneficial work of security experts.

 


In a case surrounded by 

political interests

, Ola Bini’s 

unanimous acquittal

 by the lower court in 2023 was overturned after the prosecution’s appeal. The majority of the appeals court convicted Bini

 

for


attempted unauthorized access of a telecommunications system without 

actual evidence

 to corroborate the accusation claims. 

 


Now, once again we must sound the alarm.


Ecuadorean authorities must explain

 the accusations against the sec

urity expert

. We will remain vigilant

and

 

ensure that at least this time his

rights are respected.

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Quebec Conservative Marc Damant says Nunavik needs a local MNA
content:
Nunatsiaq News reached out to each candidate running in the Ungava riding ahead of Quebec’s Oct. 5 provincial election. Here’s what Quebec Conservative party candidate Marc Damant had to share with us.


Marc Damant says he wants to represent Ungava because Nunavik needs a local representative in the Quebec national assembly.


“I think it’s time that Nunavik had someone who was more of a full-time MNA,” said Damant, who lives in Kuujjuaq and is the Quebec Conservative party’s candidate in the Oct. 5 provincial election.


He said that previous MNAs didn’t enough of an interest in the region, and that people feel like they don’t matter.


While he acknowledged logistical and financial challenges make it difficult for candidates to visit Nunavik’s villages, he said nothing beats face-to-face conversation with electors.


“We have to do better for everyone,” said Damant, adding he’s the only candidate with posters up in Kuujjuaq right now.


Damant works as an airport manager for the Kativik Regional Government, where he’s responsible for airport operations and safety for multiple communities across Nunavik. From 2007 to 2014, he was a grounds operations co-ordinator for Air Inuit, a role that allowed him to travel across Nunavik.


He also spent 11 years as a reservist in the Canadian Armed Forces and previously taught in China, Akulivik and La Tabatiere, Que. From 2010 to 2011, he was the president of the federal Conservative chapter in his riding of Lac-Saint-Louis, which represents Montreal’s West-Island, where Damant is from.


He said the Conservative party is a solid choice for federalists who want to pay less in taxes and to reduce government expenditures.


The party is promising to abolish taxes on carbon and used goods and to raise the amount citizens can earn without paying taxes from $19,000 to $35,242 by 2030. It’s also promising to reduce government spending by $47 billion over five years, by cutting public sector jobs, for example.


The party also wants to prioritize Quebec’s natural resources, he said, adding consultation is an important step in that development.


“We’re big on bringing our natural resources to market,” he said.


Damant is among five candidates running for Ungava in Quebec’s provincial election. Advance polls have been open since Saturday and will stay open until Wednesday. Election day is on Monday, Oct. 5.

author: Unknown
title: Cimici al carcere delle Vallette
content:
In questi giorni, a seguito di alcuni articoli di

giornale

 e in particolare dai racconti di alcuni detenuti recentemente usciti dal carcere torinese Lo Russo e Cutugno, sono emerse nuovamente le criticità sanitarie e di vivibilità minima della Casa Circondariale. 


In particolare è stata riportata sia dai giornali che da racconti diretti, la presenza di una infestazione di cimici da letto. Con gravi conseguenze sulla vita dei detenuti della sezione maschile. 


Le cimici da letto sono un parassita ematofago, che si nutre di sangue umano, che morde l’uomo causando lesioni cutanee della pelle solitamente in forma di gonfiore e arrossamento e prurito. In alcuni casi si possono avere anche reazioni di livello allergico più grave. Anche se non sono segnalate malattie trasmissibili tramite questo fastidioso parassita, le punture sono molto fastidiose e danno forte prurito. In più, ogni cimice morde solitamente più volte e se il materasso o la cella ne sono infestati, possono rendere la vita invivibile. Sono esseri notturni quindi concentrano l’attività nella notte, con i risvolti immaginabili per la vita dei detenuti. 


E’ un fenomeno infestante che molti conoscono magari per presa diretta o per racconti e può essere preso sottogamba, ma immaginiamo come si aggrava la situazione quando si presenta in un ambiente di scarso igiene come il carcere e dove, come in questo caso, gli interventi di disinfestazione sembrano essere nulli. 


In particolare sarebbero coinvolti sicuramente il Blocco B e la decima sezione in particolare. Ma, stando alle ricostruzioni, sembra molto probabile un’infestazione del magazzino dei materassi del carcere, oltre che delle celle. 


Il carcere non è nuovo a problemi di questo tipo: topi, scarafaggi, formiche, zanzare sono segnalati da anni, anche dai secondini. Numerose segnalazioni hanno evidenziato carenze dovute al sovraffollamento ma soprattutto alla fatiscenza della struttura. A questo si sommano la scarsità di mobilio e il fatto che in alcune sezioni non vengano distribuite abbastanza lenzuola e che i cuscini non siano un’opzione per molti detenuti.


Il fatto che una possibile infestazione da cimici da letto si possa allargare all’intero carcere, ha qualcosa di molto allarmante e non è solo una questione sanitaria, anche se le implicazioni possono essere gravi visto che anche i medicinali normalmente reperibili fuori tante volte scarseggiano. Ne va della vivibilità e sanità mentale dei detenuti. Possiamo immaginare cosa voglia dire rimanere svegli per notti e notti di fila e avere coscienza che la cella in cui si è rinchiusi è popolata da insetti che si cibano del tuo sangue? Uno stress e una tortura a cui nessuno dovrebbe essere sottoposto. 


Dopo le denunce pervenute ai giornali tramite le ispezioni della Consigliera Regionale Ravinale, difficilmente le istituzioni possono dire di non essere a conoscenza del problema e il fatto di non agire tempestivamente non può che aggravare la situazione. La salubrità è talmente deteriorata all’interno del carcere, che addirittura i sindacati della penitenziaria, fanno dichiarazioni e lamentele ogni pochi giorni. Di sicuro avranno anche altri fini, ma il quadro complessivo è drammatico. 


Chissà se il Sindaco Lo Russo, il Presidente della Regione Cirio o il ministro della Giustizia Nordio se ne fregheranno altamente anche questa volta. Certo è che i detenuti e le detenute devono aver riconosciuta la loro dignità e molte volte trovano anche da soli il modo per farla rispettare, come successo nei giorni scorsi nel carcere Don Bosco di Pisa.

author: Equality Now
title: UNGA 2026 Reflections: Legal equality, feminist multilateralism, and the road ahead
content:
2nd October 2026


UNGA 2026 Reflections: Legal equality, feminist multilateralism, and the road ahead


12 min read


News and Insights


Achieve legal equality


Global


What you’ll read:


Despite pushback, many are firmly committed to gender equality

: in a climate of global conflict and anti-rights pushback, we saw evidence of real progress, genuine political will and concrete support for gender-equal laws and policies.


Multilateralism matters more than ever, and it must include women

: alongside a UN Secretary General race featuring more women candidates than ever, we saw Member States leaning into, not away from, both multilateralism itself, and the idea that women are central to its success.


Everyone benefits from equality, and everyone has a part to play

: we know that whole societies reap the rewards of gender equality, but we also know that getting there requires all hands on deck. From intergenerational leadership to multisectoral coalitions and unexpected alliances, only by working and persevering together can we make equality reality.


The state of gender equality at UNGA 2026 and what has changed since last year


Observing the world during the UN General Assembly (UNGA) 2026, one could be forgiven for having a pessimistic outlook: since

UNGA last year

, conflicts and humanitarian crises are rampant, and concerns about weakening multilateral institutions have grown, while anti-rights movements continue to target gender equality and human rights across regions. But such a dark view of the state of things can mean we lose sight of the actual  progress and positive change that is happening, despite such forces. 


Throughout this UNGA, again and again we saw evidence of political will for advancing gender equality among many Member States. They not only proudly announced laws they had reformed, but also actively shared best practices and emphasised the importance of going beyond legal frameworks to ensure implementation. 


For possibly the first time, we heard the phrase

“feminist multilateralism”

 used by governments, and saw how discussions surrounding multilateralism are evolving beyond individual national foreign policies into collective commitments, underscored by the historic UN Secretary-General race featuring more female candidates than male candidates – meaning there is a real possibility that the next Secretary-General of the UN could be the first woman to lead it since its founding in 1945.


Highlights and key takeaways


From equality in family law and nationality rights, to economic justice, digital rights and safety and the power of intergenerational leadership, the conversations Equality Now took part in and witnessed in and around UNGA were informative and energising.


                                        Legal equality front and centre


Multiple events provided opportunities to learn about

positive law reforms

, why they benefit all of society and how they were achieved. At the Equality in Law for Women and Girls by 2030: Renewing Global Leadership event we co-sponsored with

UN Women

, the

Inter-Parliamentary Union

 and the

Global Campaign for Equal Nationality Rights

, we heard from representatives of Azerbaijan, Malaysia, Serbia, Sierra Leone and Uganda about how they’ve made their laws more gender equal. Speakers emphasised the importance of cooperation between legislators and civil society, as well as affected people. As H.E. Mr. Sofian Akmal Abd Karim, Deputy Permanent Representative of Malaysia to the United Nations, said of the constitutional reform related to nationality law in his country, “We must also acknowledge the central and important role played by Malaysian mothers themselves. Their voices, experiences, and sustained engagement contributed significantly to the national conversation on this issue, and helped build momentum for change.” 

 

We look forward to answering the event’s Call to Action from the Presidents of the Inter-Parliamentary Union and the Global Campaign for Equal Nationality Rights, as well as Nyaradzayi Gumbonzvanda, Deputy Executive Director of UN Women, to make legal equality a reality for everyone.


At another event, together with the

World Bank

’s

Women, Business and the Law

 (WBL) division, we reiterated the connection between family law reform and economic equality – and how family law reforms benefit all of society.  This

joint event

Я замедлил с ответом моему любезному и учёному оппоненту из Conscientia. Для него это не будет иметь значения, а читатели легко простят мне задержку, видя, что в эти бурные моменты вопрос вовсе не является животрепещущим.

Тем не менее мне не кажется бесполезным попытаться внести ясность.

Г. г. из Conscientia оценил меня как обладающего «догматическим складом ума». Я ответил, и он возражает, говоря, что мой ответ подтверждает его мнение, будто у меня «сциентистский склад ума»[1]. Думает ли он, следовательно, что эти две противоположные характеристики означают одно и то же?

Я протестую против характеристики «догматик», потому что, будучи твёрдым и решительным в том, чего хочу, я всегда сомневаюсь в том, что знаю, и думаю, что, сколько бы усилий ни было приложено для понимания и объяснения Вселенной, до сих пор не достигнуто не только достоверности, но даже вероятности того, что наши знания достоверны, — и не знаю, сможет ли человеческий разум когда-либо это исправить.

Напротив, характеристика «научный склад ума» мне вовсе не неприятна, и я был бы польщён, если бы её заслужил; ибо научный склад ума — это тот, который ищет истину позитивным, рациональным и экспериментальным методом, никогда не обольщается мыслью, что нашёл абсолютную Истину, и довольствуется тем, что с трудом к ней приближается, открывая частичные истины, которые всегда считает предварительными и подлежащими пересмотру. Учёный, каким он, по моему мнению, должен быть, — это тот, кто исследует факты и делает из них логические выводы, какими бы они ни были, в противоположность тем, кто создаёт себе систему и затем ищет ей подтверждение в фактах, а чтобы найти его, бессознательно выбирает факты, которые им подходят, пренебрегая другими и, может быть, насилуя и искажая реальность, чтобы втиснуть её в тиски своих концепций. Он использует рабочие гипотезы, то есть делает предположения, которые служат ему руководством и стимулом в его исследованиях, но не остаётся жертвой своих фантазий, принимая, в силу привычки к ним, свои предположения за доказанные истины и обобщая и возводя в закон, с произвольной индукцией, каждый частный факт, который подходит к его тезису.

Сциентизм, который я отвергаю и который, вызванный и питаемый энтузиазмом, последовавшим за поистине изумительными открытиями, сделанными в ту пору в области физикохимии и естественной истории, господствовал над умами во второй половине прошлого века, — это вера в то, что наука есть всё и может всё; это принятие как окончательных истин, как догматов, каждого частичного открытия; это смешение Науки с Моралью, Силы в механическом смысле слова, которая есть сущность определяемая и измеримая, с моральными силами, Природы с Мыслью, естественного Закона с Волей. Он логически ведёт к фатализму, то есть к отрицанию воли и свободы.

Г. г. говорит, что следовало бы обсуждать мою статью фраза за фразой, что было бы слишком долго, и потому ограничивается тем, что ставит мне вопросы, чтобы я убедился, насколько его постановка проблем далека от моей. Я уже был убеждён; но вот:

Я говорил, что не верю в божественное происхождение Священного Писания, и он отвечает: Но что понимает Малатеста под Священным Писанием? Бумагу и печатные слова? Нет, я не дохожу до предположения, что г. г. верит, будто Предвечный Отец на горе Синай или где-либо ещё написал что-то на папирусе или в священных книгах; но верит ли он, да или нет, что Библия боговдохновенна, а не является собранием легенд и поэзии, чем-то вроде фольклора еврейского народа?

Что понимает Малатеста под божественным происхождением? Если под божественным он допускает то, что абсолютно, не эмпирично, то Малатеста признает, что по крайней мере сознание имеет божественное происхождение, поскольку оно позволяет ему, Малатесте …

title: "Cruel & Torturous": Christa Pike in Critical Condition After Botched Tennessee Execution
content:
Tennessee’s Governor Bill Lee has halted executions for the remainder of the year after a death row prisoner survived two lethal injections on Wednesday. According to her lawyers, Christa Pike was still breathing after she was strapped to a gurney and injected with two syringes of pentobarbital in a botched execution that spanned more than two hours. Prior to the scheduled execution, Pike and her lawyers argued a single-dose lethal injection could be tantamount to torture due to Pike’s small veins. Pike was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder she committed when she was 18. Now in the hospital in critical condition, she is the first person to ever survive lethal injection in the United States.


“I have seen five executions in Tennessee,” says Steven Hale, a criminal justice reporter for the

Nashville Banner

, who witnessed Christa Pike’s botched execution. “And I’ve never seen anything like what we saw Wednesday night.”


Christa Pike “has just experienced the most agonizing attempt at lethal injection in the country’s history,” says Sandra Babcock, director of the Cornell Center on the Death Penalty Worldwide. Babcock says Pike should have never been sentenced to death, because she was an “immature 18-year-old” with a history of severe childhood and sexual trauma who “was not receiving medication for post-traumatic stress disorder and bipolar disorder at the time of [the murder], which she committed with her abusive boyfriend at the time.”

title: La vera faccia dei data center: cosa succede in Piemonte?
content:
Di seguito l’indizione del dibattito organizzato dai comitati e dai cittadini che si stanno attivando a Torino sul tema dei data center insieme all’

Assemblea Universitaria di Scienze di UniTo

.


DIBATTITO


MERCOLEDì 21 OTTOBRE ORE 17.30

–

DIPARTIMENTO DI FISICA, AULA C, VIA PIETRO GIURIA 1 – TORINO

.


Riteniamo che l’università possa avere un ruolo centrale in questo dibattito. La

comunità scientifica ha le competenze adatte a valutare da vicino gli aspetti tecnici

, sia della realizzazione dei data center

sia della valutazione del loro impatto sull’ambiente

: servono fisici per l’analisi termica, chimici per l’analisi degli agenti inquinanti, medici per valutarne gli effetti sulla salute e biologi per studiarne l’impatto sul territorio. Questi saperi devono essere messi a disposizione dei territori impattati da questi nuovi progetti.

Ma non solo: è proprio all’interno delle università, e in particolare nei poli STEM, che tecnologie come l’AI vengono sviluppate.

 


I data center assumono un ruolo importante in questa

fase di guerra

: possono essere obiettivo o strumento, così come l’energia

nucleare

 che viene sponsorizzata per risolvere il problema dell’enorme richiesta energetica che queste macchine impongono al territorio. Il governo parla di

“interesse strategico nazionale”

 in merito a queste grandi opere, eppure la proprietà dell’infrastruttura e dei dati è sovranazionale, essendo molto spesso i promotori le

Big Tech americane.

 A seguito di un’estate di

blackout

 e di

ondate di calore

 l’esplosione di progetti di data center anche in Piemonte è un paradosso da fermare immediatamente. 


Questo primo evento pubblico avrà l’obiettivo di

informare sugli impatti ambientali e sociali

 dei data center e di approfondire i

progetti

 che fanno capolino sul nostro territorio: da

Grugliasco

 a

Trino Vercellese

, da

Caselle

 a

Lucento

 fino al progetto hyperscale di

Moncalieri

 in modo da iniziare a creare

rete tra comitati, cittadini, universitari e esperti

 che vogliono opporsi a questi progetti che avranno un costo ingente per la nostra salute e per la nostra vivibilità sia in termini ecologici sia economici. 


Ne parleremo con: 


Enrico Duranti

, portavoce della Rete dei Comitati STOP Data Center Lombardia; 


Francesco Cappello

, fisico, Direttivo COMITATO NO GUERRA NO NATO, Vice presidente Associazione Per un mondo senza guerre;


Sergio Manera

, fisico.

title: "DYAyê bataryayên nû yên Patriotê şandin Qeter û Erebistana Siûdî"
content:
Malpera nûçeyan Axiosê ku navenda wê li DYAyê ye nivîsî ku artêşa DYAyê bi mebesta parastina tesîsên krîtîk ên neft û xaza sirûştî yên li Erebistana Siûdî û Qeterê, du bataryayên din ên parastina esmanî yên Patriotê şandin herêmê.


Li gorî nûçeyê, DYAyê yek ji van bataryayan li nêzî tesîseke giring a neftê ya li Erebistana Siûdî û ya din jî li nêzî tesîseke xaza sirûştî ya li Qeterê bi cih kir.


Axiosê nûçeya xwe spartiye rayedarên DYAyî û çavkaniyeke ji herêmê. Çavkaniyan diyar kir ku Washîngton bi vê gavê dixwaze baweriyê bide Erebistana Siûdî û Qeterê.


Li gorî çavkaniyan, rêveberiyên Riyad û Dohayê fikar dikin ku di rewşa ji nû ve destpêkirina êrişên berfireh ên DYAyê yên li ser Îranê de, Tehran binesaziya wan a energiyê bike hedef.


Rêveberiya Trump di dawiya Tîrmehê de vebijêrkên êrişên berfireh ên li ser binesaziya enerjiyê ya Îranê nirxandibû. Têkildarî vê yekê, Mîrzayê Erebistana Siûdî Mihemed bin Selman di hevdîtina 1ê Tebaxê ya bi Trump re de fikarên xwe yên li ser zêdebûna rageşiyê aniye ziman û daxwaz kiriye ku ji êrişan dûr bisekine. Welatên herêmê ku Qeter jî di nav de ye di heman serdemê de bang li Washîngton û Tehranê kiribûn ku rageşiyê kêm bikin.


Trump di 2yê Tebaxê de diyar kir ku di muzakereyan de pêşketin çêbûye û êrişa ku dihat plan kirin, betal kir. Rêveberiya DYAyê di hefteyên dawî de zextên aborî û ambargoyên li ser Îranê zêde kirin.


Di şerê DYA-Îranê de rewşa dawî


Êriş ji heft mehan derbas bûn:

 DYA û Îsraîlê di 28ê Sibatê de li dijî Îranê êrişên berfireh dan dest pê kirin. Îranê jî di dirêjahiya şer de bi êrişên mûşekan û balafirên bêmirov bersiv da Îsraîl û hebûna leşkerî ya DYAyê ya li herêmê.


Dîplomasî berdewam dike:

 Di serî de Qeter û Pakistan navbeynkar, ji bo peymana ku dê şer bi dawî bike û Tengava Hurmuzê ji nû ve veke bi aliyan re hevdîtinan dikin. Rêveberiya Tehranê ragihand ku bersiva fermî ji bo teklîfa wan a dawî ya peymanê hatiye dayîn, lêbelê naveroka bersivê bi raya giştî re parve nekir.


Trump rêya îhtimala êrişên nû vekirî hişt:

 Serokê DYAyê Trump got ku wan teklîfa dawî ya Îranê kêm dîtine û îhtimala zêdekirina bombebaranên li ser Îranê ya piştî hilbijartinên navberê ên 3ê Mijdarê yên DYAyê ji holê ranekir.


Riska li Hurmuzê berdewam dike:

 Şer, trafîka behrê ya di tengava krîtîk a ji bo bazirganiya enerjiyê ya cîhanê de bi awayekî cidî asteng kir. Navenda Operasyonên Bazirganiya Deryayî ya Brîtanyayê di 1ê Cotmehê de ragihand ku tiştekî ku çavkaniya wî nehat diyar kirin li tanker e ku di Tengava Hurmuzê re derbas dibû ketiye û agir bi tankerê ketiye. Zirar negiştiye karmendan û ti aliyekî berpirsiyarî negirt ser xwe.


DYA hebûna xwe ya leşkerî ya li herêmê zêde dike:

 Li gorî nûçeya APê ku navenda wê li DYAyê, rayedarekî DYAyî ê ku navê xwe nedaye, koma keştiya balafiran a Theodore Roosevelt û koma amfîbî ya Makin Island ber bi herêmê ve diçin. Ev tevgerana dikare bibe sedem ku ber bi dawiya Cotmehê ve sê keştiyên balafiran ên DYAyê di heman demê de li herêmê bin.


Bandorên aborî û sivîl girantir dibin:

 DYAyê di 1ê Cotmehê de ambargoyên nû anîn ser beşa otomotîv û rêhesinî ya Îranê. APê her wiha ragihand ku riyalê Îranê di dawiya Îlonê de ketiye asta xwe ya herî jêrîn a nû, bihayên dermanan bi lez zêde bûne û gihîştina hinek dermanan zihmettir bûye.


(VC/AY)

title: Eleições 2026 além da disputa presidencial – com Tathiana Chicarino
content:
“A gente fala muito pouco sobre partidos políticos, mas, exceto para o Senado, nós votamos no partido e não na pessoa”, afirma a cientista política Tathiana Chicarino. Coordenadora do curso de Sociologia e Política da FESPSP e pesquisadora do O

bservatório de Conflitos Online da UFABC

, a entrevistada do Pauta Pública desta semana fala sobre os riscos da personalização da política, o papel das redes sociais nas campanhas e a importância de olhar além da disputa presidencial.


Às vésperas das

eleições de 2026

author: Lucas Santos
title: Dos clubes de tiro ao poder: segmento de armas injeta quase R$ 1,5 milhão nas eleições
content:
Investigamos o que importa para os brasileiros além do que passa na campanha eleitoral. Leia mais reportagens como essa clicando

aqui

.


O mercado do tiro participa das eleições financiando campanhas e lançando candidatos próprios, enquanto alguns parlamentares eleitos defendem suas pautas no Congresso. Cem empresários de clubes de tiro e fabricantes, comerciantes e importadores de armas despejaram R$ 1,46 milhão na campanha deste ano, seja em doação direta para candidatos ou para o diretório de partidos políticos, revela cruzamento de dados feito pela

Agência Pública

.


O levantamento, que considera as doações registradas no Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) até 30 de setembro, mostra que 96 candidatos receberam R$ 1,2 milhão de empresários ligados a clubes de tiro e empresas que fabricam, vendem ou importam armas e munições. Diretórios de sete partidos receberam também R$ 261 mil de financiamento deste setor, dos quais R$ 176 mil em doações diretas dos empresários.


Há ainda 28 sócios e administradores que registraram candidaturas próprias – metade deles concorrem pelo PL, partido do candidato à presidência Flávio Bolsonaro. Eles disputam principalmente cargos de deputado estadual (17), mas há registros para deputado federal, vice-governador e 1º suplente de senador.


Entre os candidatos que receberam doações desses empresários, estão nomes conhecidos, como os deputados federais

Nikolas Ferreira

 (PL-MG),

Kim Kataguiri

 (Missão-SP) e

Julia Zanatta

 (PL-SC), que concorrem à reeleição. Com exceção de Zanatta, que recebeu R$ 5 mil, os outros dois deputados receberam valores baixos, inferiores a R$ 400 reais. Os três defenderam ou beneficiaram o setor durante seus mandatos.


As maiores quantias foram recebidas pelos candidatos filiados ao PL (R$ 420 mil), ao Republicanos (R$ 153 mil) e ao Novo (R$ 133 mil) – juntas, as três legendas de direita e extrema direita concentram quase 60% dos R$ 1,2 milhão doados a candidatos.


As doações registradas até agora são menores do que as computadas nas eleições de 2022, quando 118 empresários do setor doaram R$ 2,69 milhões a 126 candidatos e R$ 89 mil a partidos políticos.


O cruzamento considerou todos os clubes de tiro, fabricantes, vendedores e importadores de armas e munições com registro no Exército e cruzou com a base de dados da Receita Federal para chegar aos nomes dos sócios e administradores. Desde 2015, é proibido que empresas façam doações a campanhas políticas – esse espaço é hoje ocupado por pessoas físicas.


A doação de campanha é permitida por lei e não implica nenhuma irregularidade. Ela, no entanto, pode ser um indicativo dos setores que serão defendidos e beneficiados caso os financiados sejam eleitos.


Para Carolina Ricardo, diretora-executiva do Instituto Sou da Paz, esse apoio eleitoral ajuda a sustentar uma agenda do setor, que passa pela compra de armas, pela redução da tributação e pelo funcionamento dos clubes.

“O lobby parlamentar visa prioritariamente à aprovação de projetos de lei que flexibilizem o comércio, ampliem o porte de armas para categorias funcionais, diminuam tributos e reduzam o controle estatal sobre os clubes de tiro. Apoiar candidatos alinhados garante uma bancada ativa e comprometida com a ampliação contínua das garantias econômicas e operacionais do setor”, analisa a especialista.


Na avaliação de Felippe Angeli, coordenador de advocacy do Justa, a proibição de doações empresariais em 2015 mudou a forma de participação desse mercado no financiamento eleitoral. “Desde a proibição de doações de pessoas jurídicas, donos e executivos das grandes indústrias, além de empresários de clubes de tiro, continuam doando como pessoas físicas. Eles encaram essas doações como investimento estratégico”. A leitura do coordenador descreve a articulação do setor – os registros de doação, isoladamente, não são suficientes para revelar a motivação de cada financiador.


Conflito de interesses?


Julia Zanatta (PL-SC) é uma dessas pontes entre o setor e o Congresso. Aos 41 anos, a

catarinense natural de Criciúma

 construiu sua ascensão política alinhada ao bolsonarismo e às pautas conservadoras. Formada em jornalismo e direito, Zanatta chegou à Câmara na eleição de 2022 e fez da defesa das armas uma marca do mandato. Em 2025, ela destinou uma emenda parlamentar de R$ 800 mil (posteriormente ampliada para cerca de R$ 999 mil) para a prefeitura de São José, em Santa Catarina, contratar um clube de tiro de um aliado seu para realizar …

author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: Greens to Announce Plan for ‘Emergency Brake’ on Rent Hikes
content:
Green party leader Zack Polanski will set out plans for a three-year emergency brake on rent hikes to give renters “breathing space”.


The move would limit rises to whichever is lowest between Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation, wage growth or 2% – echoing existing metrics for pensions, which currently increase by the highest of either inflation, wage growth or 2.5%.


Under the proposal, landlords would not be able to put up rents by more than the lowest of the three measures, which the Greens say would protect tenants from being forced out by sudden rent hikes.


Addressing delegates at the Green party conference in Brighton on Friday, Polanski will also set out plans for a “fair rents guarantee” that would keep rents “fair and affordable” once the emergency brake expires after three years.


The party says the temporary cap would give wages time to catch up with rents, which have risen faster than incomes.


“For too long, landlords have been able to hike prices way beyond wages,” Polanski is expected to say.


“That’s why today I’m calling for a three-year emergency brake on private rents. No rent rises above CPI, wage growth or 2% – whichever is lower. No sudden hikes. No evictions under the guise of rent rises. No more fear and uncertainty.”


Polanski will use his conference speech to highlight the impact of high rents on younger people and families, including people forced to remain in or return to their parents’ homes.


Carla Denyer, Green MP for Bristol Central, said the policy would provide a “much-needed reset” while the government develops a longer-term system of rent controls.


Average monthly rent in England is now £1,459, the

Office for National Statistics (ONS) said in August

. That’s more than half the median monthly salary of £2,657, which amounts to £1,887 in take-home pay. 


The Green party says this weekend’s party conference in Brighton is its biggest ever, after membership tripled following Polanski’s election as leader just over a year ago.


On 1 May, the Labour governments’ Renters’ Rights Act came into force in England, putting an end to no-fault evictions, fixed-term contracts and bidding wars. The legislation was billed as the biggest overhaul to the private rental sector in a generation.

content:

В нашем номере от 15 августа, говоря о Религиозной реформе, в примечании к статье, в которой товарищ Бениньо Бласко занимался протестантской пропагандой журнала Coscientia, я говорил:

Мы (в религию) не верим; и поэтому не можем основывать нашу мораль на том, что считаем ложью, будь то католической или протестантской.

Если бы «Coscientia» могла дать нам веру! Но как она могла бы это сделать? Мы хотели бы доказательств и сомневаемся, что можно доказать истинность христианских догматов.

«Coscientia» находит, что я «грубо поставил вопрос в точных терминах», и в свою очередь отвечает:

«Coscientia», если не может дать веру, может дать такой ответ: Существуют два склада ума: 1° догматический, который считает, что нашёл окончательную истину, заключённую в нём самом, не знает мук или беспокойства новых исканий и судит всё, что находится вне его, как суеверие, низший продукт и так далее. Примерами служат католический склад ума и тот естественно-правовой [от естественного права], который является карикатурной проекцией первого. Догмату о непогрешимости Папы точно соответствует догмат о непогрешимости Науки. Многие анархисты обладают этим складом ума, и он проявляется совершенно ясно в требовании доказательства христианских догматов, которое предъявляет нам Малатеста (вот догмат доказательства); 2° критический склад ума: этот исключительно современный, живёт сомневаясь; вера никогда не является окончательной или такой, которой обладают так, чтобы не искать лучшего, и ценность её заключается в воле к ней, в тяжком приобретении, так же как либерализм не в политической программе, а в себе самом, как философия – в философствовании. Это религиозное открытие Кальвина, философское Гегеля, политическое Стюарта Милля, – словом, открытие иной культуры, у которой тоже есть неверующие, но иного рода и менее неверующие, чем принято думать. Кроче, например, никогда не потребует доказательств божественности Христа.

Учитывая это, становится ясной трудность для догматического склада ума понять критический склад ума, который был путём к тому, чтобы стать тем, что мы есть. Следовало бы сомневаться в собственных идеях, а это не входит в намерения Малатесты, о чьей упорной привязанности к своим принципам мы знаем в часы печальные и безмятежные.

Словом, здесь вопрос воли и расположения; того, что Паскаль называл волей к вере, прежде чем быть вопросом веры.

Это ответ, возможно, немного длинный, но не бесполезный для того, чтобы прояснить термины некоторых разногласий.

Coscientia судит обо мне плохо. Что бы ни думали другие анархисты, я отвергаю как естественное право восемнадцатого века, так и сциентизм девятнадцатого; и прежде всего я не догматик. Я не верю в непогрешимость Науки, ни в её способность всё объяснить, ни в её миссию регулировать поведение людей, как не верю в непогрешимость Папы, в Мораль Откровения и в божественное происхождение Священного Писания.

Я верю только в то, что может быть доказано; но прекрасно знаю, что доказательства – вещь относительная и могут, и действительно постоянно, быть превзойдены и отменены другими доказанными фактами; и поэтому я считаю, что сомнение должно быть умственной позицией всякого, кто стремится всё больше приближаться к истине, или по крайней мере к той доле истины, которую возможно достичь.

Coscientia говорит, что надо иметь волю к вере, признавая тем самым, что вера есть феномен самовнушения, ни в чём не соответствующее объективной реальности. И поэтому она не желает слышать о доказательствах и считает признаком догматического склада ума требовать их, тогда как, напротив, признаком критического склада ума было бы верить, естественно, без доказательств, что есть Бог, создавший Мир из ничего, что этот Бог разделился на три лица и послал одно из них, сына …

author: Habib Badawi
title: The Salvador Pass: How a Nameless Desert Gap Became a Battleground for Libya’s Warlords
content:
A failed prisoner exchange in Niger has revealed a complex network of Libyan, Nigerien, Chadian, and Russian interests converging on one of the Sahara’s most established smuggling corridors.


On the maps that colonial cartographers drew of the Sahara, most features carry the names of the people who ‘discovered’ them, or of the places they resembled. The origin of the name given to the gap in the escarpment where Libya, Niger and Algeria meet is murkier:

old French military survey maps

 simply labelled it ‘

Passe de Salvador

,’ and no definitive account of whom or what it honours has survived into the public record. What is well documented is what the pass has been used for ever since:

for centuries, it has been one of the best-known smuggling corridors in the Sahara

, moving fuel, cigarettes, migrants and weapons between three states at the exact point furthest from any of their capitals.


This very obscurity is significant. In the current year, the desert region surrounding the pass, sometimes referred to as the Salvador Triangle, has emerged as an active arena for both warlords and great-power politics, with implications extending well beyond southern Libya.


For readers less familiar with the region, the essential political map is this: Libya has had two rival governments since its 2014 civil war — a UN-recognised administration in Tripoli, in the west, currently led by Abdulhamid Dbeibah, and a rival administration in the east, based in Benghazi and controlled militarily by Khalifa Haftar. Niger has been run by a military junta since a 2023 coup, led by General Abdourahamane Tiani; Chad’s government, headed by Mahamat Idriss Déby, emerged from a similar military transition after his father’s death in 2021. Algeria, the region’s traditional power broker, is a civilian-led state with its own long-standing interests in Sahelian stability. It is the overlapping ambitions of these governments — together with Russia, which backs actors on more than one side at once — that converge on the Salvador Pass.


This analysis is based on several months of interviews and documents collected by the research network, including discussions with a Libyan military source possessing direct knowledge of Benghazi’s engagement in Niger and Chad.


A prisoner swap that never happened


For years, the eastern Libyan camp led militarily by

Khalifa Haftar

 — and increasingly run day-to-day by his son

Saddam Haftar

 — quietly built its own channels into Niger and Chad, using tribal networks and smuggling routes around the Salvador Pass that predate every modern state in the region. At the centre of that relationship was a straightforward transaction: Benghazi wanted the extradition of a detained Libyan figure,

Rifi Bahr al-Din

, held in Niger since mid-2025; in exchange, it would release

Mahmoud Saleh

, head of the National Front for the Liberation of Niger — an armed Nigerien opposition movement —, then in eastern Libyan custody.


The agreement failed, to the disadvantage of Benghazi. According to the Libyan source, negotiations had progressed to a finalised exchange when Niger’s military authorities in Niamey instead transferred Bahr al-Din to the rival, internationally recognised government in Tripoli, led by

Abdulhamid Dbeibah

. Saleh was released from eastern Libyan custody at nearly the same time, a timing he attributes directly rather than to coincidence.


This sequencing raises an obvious question: if Niamey had already abandoned the exchange by handing Bahr al-Din to Tripoli, why would Benghazi still release Saleh? Two explanations are consistent with the reporting, and the available sources do not allow a choice between them. The first is a breakdown in communication: Benghazi may have set Saleh’s release in motion before the transfer to Tripoli reached the relevant officials, making the near-simultaneous timing coincidental after all. The second is a calculated gesture: eastern Libya may have proceeded regardless, betting that visibly honouring its side of the bargain — even after Niger had not honoured its own — preserved its credibility for future dealings with Niamey. Either way, the episode is an early instance of a pattern that recurs throughout this account: actors in this corridor keep extending themselves toward partners who have already begun hedging them.


For Benghazi, this was not merely losing a detainee. It was a message: Niger’s ruling council under

Abdourahamane Tiani

 no longer saw the …

author: Unknown
title: La banalizzazione della montagna
content:
Un articolo di Luca Rota

 – attento conoscitore delle nostre montagne e del loro ambiente naturale – offre lo spunto per

ragionare su una problematica di attualità: il turismo

.


Da Volere la luna


Si tratta, in questo caso, di uno

skywalk

, cioè

una passerella panoramica sospesa, che verrà realizzata a quasi 2600 metri di quota sopra il Passo del Tonale

 (provincia di Trento). Luca – che peraltro è sempre moderato nei giudizi – la definisce giustamente “una fesseria colossale”, semplicemente fatta per attirare turisti in una zona in cui tra l’altro essi certamente non mancano. Nello stesso blog troviamo un’altra notizia che fa sostanzialmente il paio con quella che precede:

in Valvarrone (in provincia di Lecco), si sta realizzando un nuovo ponte pedonale sospeso (il “Ponte dei Minatori”) che, una volta ultimato, sarà “il più alto d’Europa”

.


Tralasciando la considerazione che sulle Alpi italiane è tutta una corsa a chi ce l’ha più lungo (il ponte, intendo, e solitamente si tratta di ponti tibetani), queste iniziative si inseriscono chiaramente in una

visione della montagna di puro divertimento, quando


non


di pura adrenalina

 (com’era qualche tempo fa il

bungee jumping

 o salto con l’elastico, ora passato di moda). Un esempio plateale sono le sempre più frequenti

via ferrate, con le quali si riempiono le pareti di ferraglia

 per consentire a gente che non sa nemmeno legarsi in cordata di praticare itinerari che altrimenti vedrebbero solo col binocolo. Fatto salvo poi incrodarsi come spesso capita e dover chiamare il soccorso alpino.

La montagna come un luna park, quindi, che fa il paio con la ipotizzata traversata da Alagna Valsesia a Zermatt (attraverso l’intatto Vallone delle Cime Bianche) in infradito

.


Ma quello che fa più incazzare è che queste comunità locali che si fanno promotrici o comunque approvano tali infrastrutturazioni, le

spacciano come una “valorizzazione” della montagna

. Non so se si rendono conto di quanto sia stupida la locuzione “valorizzare la montagna” (o la natura in genere che sia): la montagna ha un valore in sé, fatto di rocce, piante, animali, antichi insediamenti umani. Se io ci realizzo un ponte tibetano o uno

skywalk

 il valore la montagna lo perde, non lo acquisisce: è esattamente il contrario. Questo senza contare l’antropocentrismo insito nella locuzione. E senza contare che così la montagna diventa un luogo da mordi e fuggi senza che dei luoghi ci si capisca un acca. In un’epoca in cui la Natura occorrerebbe conoscerla, invece non si perde il vizio di volerla usare. Acutamente, sempre Rota nel suo blog, rivolgendosi ai potenziali turisti: «Veramente credete che per trovare panorami “mozzafiato”, “effetti

wow

”, “adrenalina” e altre cose del genere sia necessaria una struttura artificiale? Se lo credete, state dando ragione a chi ve la propone pensando che altrimenti voi non siate in grado di godere quelle emozioni quando siete in montagna, che non potete capire, che non avete la sensibilità necessaria».

title: Soldiers attack Martyr Binevş Cemetery on Mount Gabar
content:
The Martyr Binevş Cemetery, located near the village of Basret on Mount Gabar, was damaged. It was stated that numerous gravestones bearing names had been broken.


Images reportedly showing the cemetery show numerous gravestones smashed into pieces. The cemetery was constructed between 2010 and 2014. It was reported that many PKK guerrillas who were killed in the conflicts in the region were buried there.


The cemetery had previously been attacked in 2015 and was damaged at the time by bombardments carried out both from the air and from the ground.


Relatives of those buried at the cemetery reportedly reacted to the attack after learning that the cemetery had once again been damaged.

title: Kurdish publishing is a cultural struggle, not a commercial one
content:
Diyarbakır (Amed) is welcoming autumn with a book fair. The municipality is providing free transport throughout the fair, and I take one of the buses to the venue. The fair is being held in Üçkuyular, close to the Research Hospital, and there is also a large car park. Families from across the city are visiting the fair with their children. Even so, attendance is lower than last year. I think this may be because it is a weekday, and more people are likely to attend over the weekend. Publishers are also complaining about the low turnout, particularly as stand rental fees are quite high, meaning that some may even make a loss over the nine-day fair. Temperatures in the city are also above seasonal averages, while the floor of the fairground is covered with red carpets.


The struggle for Kurdish is important


Just inside the entrance, on the left, I see Aram Publishing House. I ask Salih Keleş about the state of Kurdish-language publishing from the perspective of a publisher that produces books in Kurdish. Keleş said publishing in Kurdish was itself a field of struggle for the publishing house: “Every year, although not at the level we would like, we see growing interest in Kurdish books. This is entirely connected to the political climate. Pressure on Kurdish-language publications is a state policy. As this policy changes, the pressure on society eases, people feel more comfortable and begin to embrace their own language and literature. Looking at the latest period, Kurdish is increasingly becoming an area of interest. In this respect, it is important both to establish institutions and expand social spaces, as well as to continue the struggle for the language.”


Children’s books attract particular interest


Keleş said Kurdish-language children’s books attracted greater interest and stressed the importance of language initiatives centred on children: “There is particularly strong demand for nurseries in Kurdistan. Families who are directly connected to their own culture complain that their children speak Kurdish at home but cannot speak it in the street or in public spaces. That is why there is considerable interest in Zarokistans. Unfortunately, we have to struggle to maintain access to our own culture in both the linguistic and cultural spheres. Families are doing their part, young people theirs, publishers theirs, women theirs; every section of society is engaged in this struggle. We, too, continue to do our part.”


Our mission is to promote Kurdish


As I walk around the fairground, an exhibition titled What Is Amida Telling Us?, prepared by the Diyarbakır Promotion, Culture and Solidarity Foundation (DİTAV), catches my attention. Black-and-white photographs from the last century hang on the walls, yellowed with age and bearing the traces of time.


A little further on, I stop at the large and striking stand of Nûbihar Publishing. I ask Welat Raminazad about Nûbihar’s mission, the age range of its readership and printing costs. Raminazad said the number of people who read books in Kurdish remained very low, adding that 90 per cent of their readers were over the age of 30. 


Raminazad said: “Only 10 out of every 100 readers are children under the age of 15. At Nûbihar, we work professionally, so we do not face difficulties financially. That is because we do not approach this from an economic perspective. If we looked at it purely in economic terms, we would be making a loss. But our mission is to promote Kurdish and expand its readership.”


A message to the people of Diyarbakır


The stand of Enstîtuya Kurdî, which has made significant contributions to the Kurdish language, also catches my eye. Murat Bilgiç is at the stand. I ask him about the state of Kurdish-language publishing, a subject he has clearly given considerable thought to, and he immediately shares this message: “Interest in the fair is steadily declining, while costs are rising. People can no longer afford to buy books. No matter how much we try to distance ourselves from the economic side of the work, people are showing little interest in the fair. Our stand has books in Kurmanji and Zazaki. We are not a publishing house; we are an institute. I believe that no one at this fair has faced as many difficulties and pressures as we have over the years. But all our work is about protecting this language and serving our people. Whatever people need, we shape our work and our books accordingly. No matter how difficult things become, we will do more than …

title: Meral Danış Beştaş: Process advancing but key gaps remain
content:
Parliament will open its doors today for the new legislative year. As political attention turns to the Peace and Democratic Society Process, Peoples’ Democratic Congress (HDK) Co-Spokesperson, Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) MP and commission member Meral Danış Beştaş spoke to ANF about the course of the process, the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) ruling on the “right to hope” and the role Parliament should assume.


Meral Danış Beştaş responded to Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş’s statement that “the process is running smoothly”, saying that while it was valuable that the process was continuing, this did not mean it was progressing without problems.


Beştaş said that as of 1 October, the process would be approaching its second year and recalled that nearly two years had also passed since Abdullah Öcalan’s call of 27 February.


Beştaş said of the current stage of the process and Parliament’s responsibilities: “The process is moving forward, there is no problem in that respect, but what matters is how it is moving forward. The fact that the process itself is continuing does not mean there are no problems. The commission’s report has still not been implemented. We are all asking questions such as: ‘Will the framework law be implemented?’, ‘When will it be implemented?’ and ‘How will the transitions take place?’”


Beştaş also discussed the establishment of the parliamentary commission, saying that they had worked for a long time to bring it into being: “As someone involved in the process, as an MP, as HDK Co-Spokesperson and as a member of the commission, I know the various stages very closely. For example, we repeatedly explained why the parliamentary commission needed to be established. All of us together, as a party, as a congress and as the democratic public, kept saying, ‘It must be established as soon as possible.’ Eventually, the commission was formed.


We then encountered many other problems in the commission’s work. Mothers were not even allowed to speak Kurdish, and some of the people we wanted to hear from were not invited to give evidence.”


Beştaş said both the establishment of the commission and its visit to Imrali had come about as a result of social and political struggle, and drew attention to shortcomings in the process: “For example, there were months of debate over whether the commission should go to Imrali and meet Mr. Öcalan. That was not how it should have been. There could have been nothing more natural or necessary than for the commission to meet the main political actor in the process much sooner.


Yet this was debated publicly for months before the visit finally took place. It was incomplete and flawed. Then the report was not made public. They released it at a time they deemed appropriate and presented a summary to the commission. The framework law was also adopted amid these debates. Now the National Security Council (MGK) decision is being debated.”


Beştaş also pointed out that, alongside the shortcomings in the process, a common language of peace had still not been established. She said a significant number of government representatives continued to use the old polarising and divisive language, while the language used by both government-aligned and opposition media failed to meet the needs of the process.


Beştaş said debates shaped by old prejudices and hostile rhetoric were increasing hopelessness in society, stressing that urgent steps were needed for the process to move forward on a sounder footing.


Beştaş said the necessary working conditions had still not been created for the main interlocutor in the process and that the government had yet to set out a clear position on Abdullah Öcalan’s status. She recalled that Devlet Bahçeli had expressed a clearer position in favour of Öcalan serving as coordinator and benefiting from the “right to hope”, while the AKP government had not been sufficiently explicit on the issue.


Beştaş stressed that the process needed to be conducted openly and transparently before the public: “For example, there are steps that need to be taken immediately. The first is this: the main interlocutor in this process still does not have the necessary working conditions. Mr. Öcalan is still being held on Imrali and has still not moved to the designated compound because the board has not yet been established. He is the coordinator of that board. For him to begin working, he needs to start working together with whoever is …

title: Abdullah Öcalan’s books published in English and Swedish
content:
Abdullah Öcalan’s book “The Civilizational Crisis in the Middle East and the Democratic Civilization Solution: : Manifesto of the Democratic Civilization, Volume IV” has been published in English by PM Press.


The Sociology of Freedom in Swedish


Öcalan’s work, "Manifesto of Democratic Civilization, Volume 3: The Sociology of Freedom" will be published in Swedish ("Manifest för en demokratisk civilisation, volym 3: Frihetens sociologi") this week. The book was translated into Swedish through a collaboration between Federativ Förlag and Heval Förlag, the publishing house of the Rojava Committees.


A launch of the book will be held on Sunday, 4 October in Stockholm. Participants will include the book’s translator, Tomas Petterson; political writer Gabriel Kuhn; and a member of the Academy of Democratic Modernity.


The launch will take place from 12:00 to 16:00 at the Katasalen venue in ABF-huset, Stockholm (Sveavägen 41).

title: Three Kurdish citizens sentenced to death in Tehran
content:
The Human Rights Activists News Agency (HRANA) has published a report on the death sentences handed down to three Kurdish citizens from Rojhilatê Kurdistan.


The report states that three Kurdish citizens registered as residents of Kermanshah, Xesrew Mihemedîniya, Mesûd Toşmalanî, and Sîrwant Şehîdî (22), were arrested during protests in the capital, Tehran.


The 23rd Branch of the Tehran Revolutionary Court sentenced the three citizens to death on charges of “war against God” and “assembly and collusion against national security.”


All three citizens are reportedly being held at Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj. The report also states that a woman tried in the same case was sentenced to five years in prison, and that her proceedings were still at the investigation stage.

title: Эррико Малатеста - Наука и Анархия
content:
Автор

: Эррико Малатеста

Название

: Наука и Анархия

Дата

: 1 июля 1925

Дополнительная информация

:

Источник

: Pensiero e Volontà №8


Так называемая «мелкая буржуазия», та, «что учится и мыслит» за последние полвека итальянской жизни, – хотя и не освободившись полностью от своей старой привычки, которая держит её настороже перед народными движениями, – поняла обновление коллективного умонастроения и то, что старое уже невозможно было бы подогревать на старом масле метафизики, и что нужно обновляться и смотреть оком физиолога на исторические истины, чтобы не оставаться позади, дремля над старыми книгами. И так, на основе опытов учёных-естествоиспытателей XIX века, они принялись за изучение новых проблем с результатами, которые отнюдь не представляют собой тщетной попытки, каковы: «La Rivo

luzione» Феррари и «Il Naturalismo» Бовио; последняя работа, если и не вполне оригинальна, есть вполне удачное исследование натуралистической системы, положенной современной наукой.


И с этой точки зрения наука может и должна нас интересовать, поскольку она охватывает изучение тех проблем, которые связаны с общественным развитием.


В самом деле, Кропоткин, обладавший самым сложным гением анархической идеи, на вопрос, который он сам ставит в своей «Современной науке и анархии»: «Какое положение занимает анархия в великом умственном движении


XIX-го века», – отвечает:


«Анархия есть миросозерцание, основанное на механическом понимании явлений, охватывающее всю природу, включая сюда и жизнь человеческих обществ. Ее метод исследования – метод естественных наук; этим методом должно быть проверено каждое научное положение. Её тенденция – основать синтетическую философию, то есть философию, которая охватывала бы все явления природы, включая сюда и жизнь человеческих обществ и их экономические, политические, нравственные вопросы, но не впадая, однако, в ошибки, сделанные Контом и Спенсером вследствие вышеуказанных причин».


И мы полагаем, что эти исследования способствовали познанию человеческой проблемы и облегчили нашу идеальную концепцию и не могут быть исключены из нашего понимания.


Но ради Бога, пусть не смешивают великих работников мысли с интеллектуалишками, которые возвышаются до сверхкритиков только потому, что могут похвастаться университетским дипломом и настрочить три колонки писанины, чтобы изрекать ереси по великим вопросам, которые составляют предмет изучения, борьбы и жертвы поколений, – чтобы сказать, что у анархии нет своей собственной философии.


Мы признаём полезность науки – которая не есть мнимая наука сточной канавы некоторых газетчиков.


 НИНО НАПОЛИТАНО


 ***


 Определение Анархии, которое даёт Кропоткин и которое Наполитано приводит как нечто, не нуждающееся даже в обсуждении, хотя и принятое с малым критическим духом многими анархистами из-за великого и заслуженного престижа автора и его согласия с научными и философскими идеями, господствовавшими, когда анархизм начал распространяться, – представляется мне ошибочным и вредным: ошибочным, потому что оно смешивает вещи различной природы; вредным, потому что оно вынуждает даже тех анархистов, которые его принимают, барахтаться в тех противоречиях, которые подрывают рассуждения всех, или почти всех, мыслителей позитивистских и натуралистических школ, когда они занимаются вопросами морали.


 Кропоткин в своей попытке определить «

положение учения об анархии в современной науке

» находит, что «

Анархия есть миросозерцание, основанное на механическом понимании явлений, охватывающее всю природу, включая сюда и жизнь человеческих обществ

».


 Это – философия, приемлемая или нет, но, несомненно, это не наука и не Анархия.


 Наука есть собрание и систематизация того, что известно, или что считается известным: она говорит о фактах и пытается открыть закон факта, то есть условия, при которых факт необходимо происходит и повторяется. Она удовлетворяет определённые интеллектуальные потребности и в то же время является действеннейшим инструментом могущества. Указывая в естественных законах предел человеческому произволу, она увеличивает действительную свободу человека, давая ему возможность обращать эти законы в свою пользу. Она одинакова для всех и служит безразлично как для добра, так и для зла, как для освобождения, так и для угнетения.


 Философия может быть гипотетическим объяснением того, что известно, или попыткой угадать то, что неизвестно. Она ставит проблемы, ускользающие, по крайней мере до сих пор, от компетенции науки, и воображает …
